Obuuze abeeshuri: Okushushana ekintu kuraba omu miringo egi nikuhereza amakuru aha bicweka byakyo, nikibaasa kukora? Bahe ekintu eki baraashushane, orondereho omuringo gumwe. Baireke kumanya oku barikukoresa akafumu k'okupima, ngu babease kukoresa omu muringo ogu barikwenda kukora.
answer_b: Ha mbeera ebishushani 3 by'ekintu kimwe n'enyimaisho zaakyo 3; ekishushani kimwe na kimwe kibeine ebipimo by'amazima by'ekintu ekyo ebirikworekwa. Ohemu orupapura orugaburiranwe, orwine omwanya gwa buri nyimaisho, ahu abeeshuri baraayegyerereze buri kishushani, barikubiteeka omu mitwaro yaabyo. Yegyesa okucweeka ebipimo omu mulingo gwa 1:10 orikuraba omu by'okureeberaho ebirikukwata aha nshonga aha bbaaho, orikukora okubala okurikukwatana nako.
answer_c: Yoreka vidiyo erikworeka eby'okureeberera ebirooto 3 eby'ekintu. Leeta ebintu by'omutekano by'entaano omu kiraasi abeeshuri bashobore kupima obureingwa bwabyo n'omufumo. Yoreka aha bbaoodi okuhingura okucweeka okuruga omu bipimo ebi baahandiika. Koresa empapura y'ebigrafi okushushana emishwi eshatu: X, Y, Z, buri gumwe yaaba neyetantaza 30°, reero obegyese okuza omuntu omuhanda gw'okureeberera ekintu kyabo.
answer_d: Yoreka vidiyo erikushoborora emiringo eshatu ey'okureeba ekintu. Obuuze abeeshuri: okwolekwa kw'ekintu kuraba omu miringo egi nikukuha amahurire aha bicweka byakyo? Bahe ebintu byangu kweshushura emiringo yaabyo. Okwegyesa okucumya ebipimo, yoreka orikukoresa kimwe aha bintu ebi ohaire aha rupapura rw'ebigarama, orikukoresa omufumo, set square, na T-square.

question: Omwegyesereza w’ekicweka kya munaana ari kutandika omurimo n’abegi be aine ekigyendererwa ky’okuheereza abakuru abari omu ka eyombekirwe eshomero. Eki, omu kicweka eki, nibenda kukora okukusanya amakuru ahari abantu abarikugyenda omu ka n’ebyetago byabo. Aha mirimo ekurikukurira, niki ekirikubaasa kwegyesa abegi kumanya ebyetago by’abantu?
answer_a: Yombeka omuti gw'ebizibu kworeka embeera mbi, nobukuru bw'ebirikubiteera n'ebirikurugamu.
answer_b: Geranisiriza engyenderwaho ez'omukukorera hamwe n'okucweekereza ebiragiro nk'okubuuza abantu n'okubaha ebipapura by'okuzamuza, reero oteekeho emigasho yaabyo n'obubi bwaabyo.
answer_c: Shuuruza eky'omutwaro gwa SWOT ohingure omugasho gw'ekishushani, oronde ebirikukomeza amaani, emigisha, obulemi n'obutiinisa.
answer_d: Teekateekateeka oburemeezi oburikubaasa kuba nibubataataaganya, reero ocondooreze emiringo y'okuzaanira amakuru.

question: Omuhwezi omu iraaya ry'omunaana, omu isomo ry'okubanza ery'omutwe ogurikukwata aha Bintu by'Obuhangwa n'Eby'Etekinologia Ebikora Gye kandi Ebireetera Obusingye, omwegyesa atandika arikushoboorora ekirikwetwa obusingye. Kugasira abegi kwetegyereza, omwegyesa acwireho kukishoboorora ahabw'eky'okureeberaho. Niki eky'okureeberaho eki omwegyesa araabe asaasiire kugasira abegi kwetegyereza obusingye?
answer_a: Omu omuhanda, nibateeka eky'omugati kya noodles aha ky'omuro gwa nyenkyakare owa abantu bana. Abantu bashatu bonka nibo batuura kuliya kandi, ahabw'okuba baine enjara nyingi, baliya noodles zoona. Omuntu owaabaire abuzire ku araize, ab'eka nibakoresa amaani n'amaizi bw'okubanza bateeke noodles endiijo ahabw'omuntu owaabaire abuzire.
answer_b: Omurimi w’akaaya akacureezi arikusimburana okutandisa emboga ezitari zimwe ezirikwetenga emiringo etari emwe, nk’enyanya, karooti, n’amatooke omwaka gumwe, n’obushaza, ebitunguru, n’ebitoogo omwaka ogurikukuraho, ahabw’okugumya itaka kuba rirungi ahabw’ebirimwa by’omumaisho.
answer_c: Omwegyeshuri ashohoreire esimu erimu amaani make, yaatandika kugichajiinga. Obwo obwo, yaatandika kucweka omuzano, kwonka omuzano nigumara amaani g'esimu bwangu okukira encharja eri kugijuzamu. N'ekirikurugamu, esimu neija kuzima bwanyima y'obwire bukye, n'ahabw'ekyo omwegyeshuri ahindura encarjya erikwijuzamu bwangu.
answer_d: Omukozi w’emeeza narukora meeza omu muringo ogurikworeka ngu obwaraaba nasara ebice by’emeeza kuruga omu mbaaho, akoresa embaaho yoona kandi ebice ebirikushigara nabikoresa omu miringo endiijo, akikyendeza omuhendo gw’ebikoreso ebirikukoresibwa kandi n’akuzaho omuringo ogu gw’okukora nk’akamanyiso k’ekicweka kye okwongyera okutunda.

question: Omugwi gw'abanyeshuri nibakora omutaano gw'eby'omugasho ogw'ekikoranwa omukukora emirimo y'okuriisa ebinywanwa, ekyetengo eki kikazurwa ahabw'okuba omwe aha banyeshuri akasiiga ekinywanwa kye kyonka omu izooba. Kurugiirira aha mbeera erikugambwaho, niki aha bikurikukuratira omwegyesa arikubaasa kukora kworeka abanyeshuri omu kicweka eki ky'omushinga?
answer_a: Shwijuma omuringo gw'ekikorwa ky'eteknologiya eki abeeshuri b'omutwe bagambiire.
answer_b: Shoborora ebirikukwata aha kuhangwa kw'ekintu, abeeshuri bamanye oku baraayombeka ekikorwa kyabo eky'eteknologiya.
answer_c: Haandi ebi orabeireho omu maanisho g'okugyenda omu maisho omu kuzooba ekikorwa ky'eteknologiya kurugiirira aha kuteekateeka kw'ekitabo ky'ekibiina eki baahandiikairemu ebi baakozire.
answer_d:
Ekitabo ky'obwemerezo bw'omuntu omwe na ttiimu omu kukora omurimo gw'omutwe gw'eky'okureeberaho abeeshuri basaine kuteeraho omukono

Ndi nkugonza kweteera omukono aha kitabo eki nk'omwe aha ttiimu y'okukora omurimo gw'omutwe gw'eky'okureeberaho. Ninyija kukora n'amaani gangye goona, ninyoweereza obwire bwange n'obwengye bwange, kandi ninyija kwetantara ebintu byoona ebirikubaasa kureetera omurimo ogu kutaagenda omu maisho.

Ebi ndikukora:

3.  Ninyija kuteeraho amaani gangye goona kukora emirimo omu bwire.
4.  Ninyija kuteeraho amaani gangye goona kuteeraho omukono aha murimo gw'omutwe gw'eky'okureeberaho.
5.  Ninyija kuteeraho amaani gangye goona kuteeraho omukono aha ttiimu.
6.  Ninyija kuteeraho amaani gangye goona kutwara omu maisho omurimo gw'omutwe gw'eky'okureeberaho.
7.  Ninyija kuteeraho amaani gangye goona kuteeraho omukono aha beeshuri abandi.

7.  Turiija kwemerera kuteeraho amaani gaitu goona kuteeraho omukono aha beeshuri abandi.

Turiija kukora twena hamwe kureetera omurimo gw'omutwe gw'eky'okureeberaho kugenda omu maisho. Turiija kuteeraho amaani gaitu goona kuteeraho omukono aha beeshuri abandi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omu kiraasi eya munaana, ahabw’obukuru bw’okugambaho ensonga ezirikukwata aha nkyukakyuka y’obwire omu kiraasi y’eby’obuhangwa, akatebeekanisiza abegyi be omurimo gw’okukora aha mutwe “Emitindo y’okukora ebintu omuri Chile n’okukora ebintu omu muringo ogurikwera.” Aha mirimo eri ahansi, niki ekirikukiraho kuteeraho okucwamu omu muringo ogurikwetegyereza aha mutwe ogu, omu kwikirizana n’omuringo ogurikugyemereza ogw’ebirikukurata aha by’okwegyesa by’ekigyendererwa ky’eisomo?
answer_a: Abeshomesha, bagaburanamo omu mitwe, bagyenda aha makampani agari haihi kwega ebikwatiraine n'omuringo gw'okukora ebintu. Bwanyima, bateekaniza lipooti erimu ebyo barikwega kuruga omu kutaayaaya kwabo hamwe n'endowoza yaabo aha miringo y'okukora ebi barikureeba.
answer_b: Abeshuri, abarikwatanisa omu mitwe, niboonyereza kandi bakakora orutonde lw'emiringo y'okukora ebintu omu bitongole by'eby'obushangwa ebirikushaanisha omu ihanga (eby'oburimi, okucukura amabuye, eby'amakuru g'eby'enganda, n'ebindi), kuruga ahabyo nibashangwa enshonga ezirikushoboorora enkyukakyuka y'obwire.
answer_c: Abeshuri nibareeba vidiyo erikushoborora oku amateeka ga Chile gahindwire ngu enteekateeka z'okukora ebintu, k'oba n'eby'omugasho nari obuhereza, zigyende nibetantara okukora ebintu ebirikwonoona obutonde, kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okutagira carbon omu mwaka gwa 2050.
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibenda kumanya ebiriho omu kuhingura ebintu omu makampani ga Chile kandi babigyeragyeranise n'amakampani agafaanaine agataireho omukono endagaano z'okukora ebintu omu muringo ogutari kwonoonera obutonde. Bwanyima, nibahandika orupapura rw'okwebembera ab'amakampani aga okukora omu muringo ogurikwongyera amaani n'okuceekyeza akabi akarikubaasa kwonoonera obutonde.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi w'ekicweka kya munaana n'abegyesi be aha purojekiti erimu okwombeka eky'okureeberaho ky'omuringo gw'okwaka omu nju. Ku yaabaire naareeba emirimo y'abegyesi, areeba ngu ekikundi kimwe tikirikubaasa kureetera amatabaaza ga LED omu byumba ebirukuumana kwaka n'okuzima omu bwabo. Aha mirimo enyakukuratira ey'omwegyesi eyarukubaasa kuhwera ekikundi eki kwetegyereza oku barikubaasa kwombeka omuringo gw'amasannyalaze ogu barikwetaga?
answer_a: Mubagambire ngu omukago oguli ahagati y'amataala gushemereire kuba guri omuringaniza (parallel) kubaasa kuba n'obwetengwa. Reero, mubasabe kukora ekishushani ky'omukago (connection diagram) hamu n'okukikopiinga omu ky'okureeberaho ky'omuringo (model circuit).
answer_b: Shoborora emitwarize y'omuringo gw'amasannyalaze ogwa seriizi n'ogwa paralel, orikworeka ngu owa seriizi, amasannyalaze garikurabamu omuhanda gumwe, n'ahabw'ekyo etabaaza tizirikwetenga. Bwanyima, bashaba kucweka etabaaza omu muringo gwa paralel, bagyezaho bareebe ebiruga omu byo.
answer_c: Reeba omuhanda gw'amasannyalaze abu baazombire nabo, obagambire ngu okushobora etara zikakora omu bweteeka, zirina kukwatwaho omu mutandiro ogurikushushana. Bwanyima, obashabe kugarukamu ekishushani ky'amasannyalaze kuraba omu kukwata etara zoona kuruga omu isooko, kandi bazombereho omutandiro ogwo.
answer_d: Mubaze mushomeshe omulingo amataba gagenda kukora byaba gahweraine omulingo gw'omunyololo n'omunyololo ogurikwingana obwo murikwenda kuzimya hamu n'okwatsya agamu. Hanyuma, mushomeshe ekishushani ky'omunyololo eyi bazombire kushemerera okumanya empinduka ezi bagenda kukora. Obwo, mubagambire kuhweraniza amataba goona omu ky'okureeberaho kurikana n'ekishushani ekipya.

question:
Omu omukuru omu iraaya rya mushanju, aha muheru gw'eisomo rya mbere ery'omutwe "Okuhanga ebintu by'okumaraho ebizibu", omwegyesa aha abaana abari omu mitwe omurimo gw'okucweekereza ekizibu ekiri omu byombeko byabo, eki barikumaraho bwanyima omu kuhanga ekintu ky'obuhangwa. Omu iraaya erikukuraho, nibashabwa kukora ekishushani ky'ekintu ky'obuhangwa, n'emiringo eshatu n'obukuru bw'okukibaza. Omwe gwa mitwe nigushushana ekintu ekirikugaba sereero, kandi omwegyesa narora ngu omusingi gwaagwo gwine omuryango muto munonga kurikukwatagana n'obunene bw'ekintu ekirikugaba, eki kirikubaasa kuzibira omugendo gwa sereero.

Obwomeezi obuha oburikukwatana n'eisomo nibwetaaga kugumizibwamu omu mutwe ogu gw'abaana, kurugiirira aha kizibu ekirorirwe omu murimo gwabo?
answer_a: Okukoresa ebipimo, kutunga ekishushani ekirikworeka ekintu abeeshuri barikwenda kuzooka
answer_b: Okukora omuguruko gw'ekishushani, abeeshuri barikurabira omuri gwo bakakora omurimo gw'ekintu eki barikwenda kuzooka
answer_c: Okutebeekanisa, kuruga ahu abeeshuri bashobora kutebeekanisa enywanzo z'okubombeka ekintu eki barikwenda kubomba.
answer_d: Okukora ebizibu, omuri bwo abeeshuri bashemereire kushanga omutaano aha kizibu ekirikumanywa omu byombeko byabo by'okuteekyera.

question: Omwegye omwegyesa w’ekitaano yaabaasa abegyeswa be kukora omurimo omu bibiina. Ahabw’ekyo, abagambira kuleeta etaabulo erimu orutindo rw’ebintu ebirikukoresibwa, ebiciro byabyo, hamwe n’omutaano gw’ebyetengo byona omu kubanga omugasho omu kicweka ky’okutebeekanisa, nibakoresa orupapura rw’okubara. Ku yaabaasa orupapura rw’okubara orurugurirwe buri ibiina, omwegyesa akahurira omu murimo gumwe ngu ebiciro by’ekicweka tibyongaire hamwe kandi ngu omuhendo gwona ogubalirirwe guri zeero, n’obu baaba bakozeseze omurimo omuhikirire. Oburemeezi ki obu ekiibiina eki kyaine omu kukoresa orupapura rw’okubara?
answer_a: Rooramu orutabo obucell oburikwenda kubara omuhendo
answer_b: Tebeekanisa ebimanyiso by'ebye'sheeri byona omu migongo
answer_c: Shagama omuringo gw'emibaro gw'obusanduuko obukozeseibwe
answer_d: Koresa omukura ogurikukora (data validation) aha muhendo gw'ebintu

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekicweka kya mukaaga abegi be n'ekigyendererwa ekirikukurataho: "Kutaanisa ebirikukorwa by'obuhangwa bw'omulembe oburikwoleka oburemeezi oburikukomaaho n'okumanya ebyetengo ebi byagarukiremu omu mbeera ebi byakuzibwemu." Ni birikukurataho by'abegi ebirikubasiisa kworeka obuhikizi bw'ekigyendererwa ekirikutongwa omwegyesa?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebirikukwatana n'emitindo erikukora gye bumwe y'obukyeeneko obw'omutaano.
answer_b: Nibaringanisa ebyetengo ebyabaho omu bice by’okukura kw’abantu omu mbeera z’obuhangwa ezitari zimwe na n’okuhinduka kwabyo omu bwire oburikwija.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza okushushana omu mbeera z'eby'afaayo omu ebi bikoresho bya tekinologia eby'ekika kimwe byatekerezebwemu okurabira omu bwire.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza ebyetengo ebyabaireho omu kubangaanisa ebintu by'omutaano bimwe omu bwire obu byabangirwe.

question:
Omuhingyi w’omwegyesa owa klasse ya 6, omu mutwe gw’okutungura omulingo gw’okukozesa obutungi bw’amaani, alagirira abegyeswa be kukora ebintu ebindi n’ebindi. Ekikundi kimu kyakozire “enyungu y’ekihimagizo”, nibagenderera kukendeeza omulingo gwa gaasi ekukozesebwa okuteeka emmere. Omwegyesa acwireho kukora akabonero k’okucungura akahaire aha mugenderera ogu: “Kugezesa n’okucungura obukuru bw’ekikorwa kyabo eky’obuhanga.”

Ni bwiha aha bubonero oburikukurataho obworaakworeka ngu abegyeswa nibahikiiriza omugenderera ogwo ogwabaire gushimwe?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza omikorere n'emitwarize y'okukoresa eby'amaani ebi "entengo y'ekihika" erikuba eine kukora kugira ngu etereze amaani.
answer_b: Nibarikiraana emitebe egyamanyirwa (nk'enkuyo y'amajaabu) ekoresa amaani agatari gaa bulijjo kandi etunga obuhangwaazi bw'amaani oburikukora gye.
answer_c: Nibakora eby'okushoborora okutandukana omu maani agakoresibwa wakati y'ekikaikuru "magic pot" n'oburyo obundi bw'okuteeka oburikushushana nayo.
answer_d: Nibakora ekicuba ky'amagezi kirikwihurira n'omuringo engyenderwaho z'amaani agatazikirirwe n'okukoresa amaani omu muringo murungi.

question: Omwegyesereza w’ekicweka kya 7 naija kushuuruura abegi be n’ekigyendererwa ky’omutwe gw’enyegyesa ekirikukurataho: “Kutebeekanisa engyenderwaho z’okuhindura nari okutungyira ahaiguru ezirikugira omugasho omu by’obutonde bw’ensi.” Omu mbeera egi, omwegyesereza areeta oburemeezi bw’ebisasiro bingi ebirikukorwa abantu obunaku obu, narwo naruga aha byatsi bya pulasitiki. Kurabira omu kibazo eki omwegyesereza areeta, omurimo gw’okushuuruura ogurikukurataho ogurikwija kureka abegi kworeka ngu bahikiire aha by’okwega ebirikwetegerezibwa omu mutwe gw’enyegyesa?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa kubanza kuteekateeka akacupa k'omuntu omwe akarikubaasa kukwata ekintu ekirikunywewa kandi kikabaasa kunywewa hatariho bwetaazo bw'okukoresa akacumu.
answer_b: Shaba abeshomesa kubanza omukura gw'okubuurira ogurikukwata aha kukoresa amacupa agarikukoresebwa omurundi gwingi, nibahamya aha birungi ebirikuruga omu kukora eki.
answer_c: Gyezaho abeeshuri bakore okushukuruza aha bikozesebwa ebitarikwonoona obutonde bw'ensi, kandi batoore kimwe ekirikubaasa kukozesebwa omu kintu ekirimu amazzi.
answer_d: Yoreka abeshomesha ebintu ebirimu omubisi gw'ebibala ebiriyo, ohabalarize kuteebereza ebirikukwataho obutonde bw'ensi bibiri ebya buri kimwe kurugiirira aha migisha yaabyo n'omugasho gwabyo omu by'obushubuzi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegisha w’ekyangahesha eky’omukaaga okukora omurimo ogurikukorerwa omu kibina: kuhindura ebintu by’obuhangwa obwangu omu muringo murungi, bwanyima mubehereze ekintu eki kandi mushoboorore ahabwaki kirikubaasa kureebwa nk’ekirikwombeka. Ni ndyoha omu kushoboorora oku kuruga aha banyeshuri kurikumanyisa ngu nibetegyereza eky’obwombeki?
answer_a: Ekintu eki kishasha ahabw’okuba tukakikoraaho empinduka ezirikyorobiha kukikoresa.
answer_b: Ekintu eki kishasha ahabw’okuba tukakihindura kimwe, n’omugasho gwakyo tigukiri gumu.
answer_c: Ekintu eki kishasha ahabw’okuba twongyeireho ebintu bisya okukireetera kuba eky’omutaano n’ekirikuruura omutima.
answer_d: Ekintu eki kikorwa kikusya ahabw'okuba tukahindura ebishushani byakyo kwikiriza abantu ab'emyaka etari emwe.

question:
Omugyezaho asomesa abegi b'omu mwaka ogw'omunaana, nk'omutwe gw'eky'omwiguta, ebirikurugamu omu kukoresa oburinganiza obwingi ebikoreso bya kompyuta omu by'omwegaano. Kuherize kworeka omutwe, abegi abagambira kushashuura amakuru ahurikwenda aha mutwe ogwo omukikoreso ky'omukura gw'omunshashuura.
Ni buhabuzi ki arikubaasa kuha abegi kubaasa kutunga amakuru agahikire aha mutwe ogwo omu by'omukura gw'omunshashuura ogutari gumwe?
answer_a: Shuuruura omuhendo gw'ebirikukoresibwa n'ebindi ebiri ahansi, orondera ebi biri eby'ahaiguru n'ebindi ebiri omukitabo, orondera ebi biri eby'abantu abamanyirwe nari abarikukiikirira abandi, oreekye okubanza kushanga emikutu mikuru kuraba omu mazina gaayo: .org (ekibiina), .gov (gavumenti n'ebitongore byayo) na .edu (ebyetegyereza). Koresa ebigambo ebirikushobora kurondera ebi orikurondera nari oteeke ebigambo omu mashine erikurondera ebintu, kubaasa kuremesa ebirikurugamu.
answer_b: Kutandika n'okushaka ebirikugarukwamu bingi, orikukoresa ebigambo ebihindurirwe, nk'eky'okureeberaho: okukoresa ebiringi, otarikukoresa turukwota. Reero okomereze okushaka kw'aawe orikuhandiika emigaanuro erikukiraho kwetegyereza, nk'eky'okureeberaho: okukoresa ekiringi okumara obwire oburikukira aha ssaaha munaana ezirikukuriraana. N'okutebeekanisa eihanga, orurimi, ebigambo by'omutaano, n'obwire obw'okuhindura ebiri omutwe gw'ebirikukiriraana. Teeka omugaanuro omu turukwota kandi okorese akamanyiso + na –, kwongyeraho ekigambo ky'omutaano nari okugyaho ebyo tutarikwenda.
answer_c: Yoorozaho engyenderwaho erikukora omu bwangu kandi eyihuta (ijuka ngu obwingi bw'ebitereke by'ebyahandiikwa engyenderwaho erikukora erikugyendera, nikwo erikukora butooshe). Reero shaka amakuru orikutoraho eihanga ei orikwenda kumanyaaho n'ekicweka ky'enshonga, nk'eky'okureeberaho: saayansi, tekinoloji, okweshemeza, emizaano. Ahabw'okushaka, koresa ebigambo bya buliijo, otakoresa obubonero nari enyuguta nkuru; ku oraabe noomanya oku ekigambo kirikubaasa kureebeka, kishuure otyo omu " ", n'ebigambo byoona.
answer_d: Okora kutebeekanisa omurimo ogurikugira, omu kimwe aha bicweka by'omurimo, okukunganya n'okukorera hamwe eby'okurorraho aha mutwe ogurikukyeruurwa. Ku orikuhika aha kicweka eki, ya omu mahano g'ebirikukwasisa nk'ebitabo, magazini, empapura, database aha Internet, ahu omutwe gurikushwijumwa omu muringo murungi. Yetegyereza munonga enyuguta nkuru n'ento ku orikuhandiika ebitabo. Yegyendesereza aha bishushani omu izooba nari ekigambo ekirikushaka, kwongyera kwetegyereza okushaka n'okuhwerekyereza ebirikugaruka.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekicweka kya munaana, omu ishomero ry'okutandika omutwe, ayoreka vidiyo "Chile, ekicweka ekirungi kuruta byona eky'okutambula omu byaro omu nsi yoona". Hanyuma, omwegyesa asaba abegyeshwa kweshomesa omu bibinja aha intaneeti aha bicweka by'okutambula omu ihanga, nibakoresa emiteresho y'okwesigwa kw'amashomo n'obuhangwa bwayo. Omu kweshomesa, niki ekikwihiire abegyeshwa kukora kwihikiiriza emiteresho enu?
answer_a: Reeba omuhandiiki n'okuhindurwa kw'ebirikukorwa
answer_b: Reeba obuhangwa bw'ebirikukwata aha matungo n'obushoboorozi bw'okuhindura amakuru.
answer_c: Ndyoleka ebiri omunda y'omukura gw'omukuraate n'okubaasa kwagwo okukuratirwa abantu baingi.
answer_d: Reeba omuko gw'omukura gw'omutandiko n'okumanya ngu ebiriho tibihinduka.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omukuru omu ishomero erikuru abegyi n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: "Manya emigisha mirungi nari emibi erikubaasa kuruga omu buhanga bw'omulembe oburikukora aha butonde bw'ensi n'abantu." Ku yaheereza orubazo kandi yashoboorora oku obuhanga butarikukora gye ahabw'okubura ebintu ebimwe ebyetengwa omu kukura kwabo, omwegyesa akamanya ngu omukago tigurikwetegyereza gye kandi acwiremu kuteeramu eky'okureeberaho kwongyera aha kushoboorora kwe. Eky'okureeberaho ki aha ebi erikubaasa kukoresibwa omwegyesa kushoboorora eky'okushoboorora kwe?
answer_a: Oburemeezi omu kucweera omu kuguura eby'okukora by'eishingiro ahabw'okuba tiririmu matungo g'eby'obushubuzi agahikire kukikora.
answer_b: Obwahati bw’okubura enteekateeka n’obwegendereza kuruga omu buteera bwa gavumenti z’ebicweka niburemesa okuteekateeka n’okuhumuza omu kukura kw’etekinolojiya y’okukwata amaizi g’enkuba.
answer_c: Okugyenda omu kuzooka omurimo gwa gavumenti, nk'ogu nk'ahaabarabara, ogurikurabura ahabw'okuba itaka eririkwetagisa riri ery'abantu banaku.
answer_d: Eky'okucwerwa kw'ebimwe aha makampani g'emotoka kurekyera aho kukora emotoka ezirikukozesa amafuta ag'omutaka ahabw'okubura kw'amafuta ago omu biro by'omumaisho

question: Omuhangu omwegyegyesa arikubaasa kuha omwegi kwetegyereza gye ekibuuzo eki?
answer_a: Ekyahandiikwa kikusangwa kiri obuhangwa obuhya bwaba nibwo butakahwereireho. Nikyo kimwe n'okuhindura ebintu; byaba nibimanyirwa ahabw'obuhangwa bwabyo obwingi, obwo nibwo buhanga obuhya.
answer_b: Ekyahandiikwa ekihangire buri obutoosha n'ekihandiikwa ekitungire ahabw'okuba obumanyi obuhyaka n'eby'obuhangwa bikozesebwa kukizooka. Nikwo kigwa n'ekintu ekyahindurwa, ahabw'okuba kirimu okukozesa eby'obuhangwa ebihyaka.
answer_c: Ekyahandiikwa n'okukoresa ekyahurikwa ky'ekintu ekyaaba kihisiriire nari kitarikumanywa, hoona obuhanga nikyo kureeta ebiteekateeko by'obuhangwa obusya omu kuhindura ebintu nari enkora ezirikwo.
answer_d: Okuhangaara nikikwaata aha kureeta ekiteekerezo omu bwomeezi okukihindura ekintu ekirikukwatwaho ekyabaireho, kandi eki kiija kuba kigasiire abantu baingi, kyahikiiriza ekyetengo kyabo, nikyo kiba kihangirwe kisya.

question: Omu omwaka gwa 11 omu mutwe ogurikukwata aha Migabo y'omu Kitongore, omwegyesa nagira abegyi bakoresa omulingo gw'okugumaho omu mirimo yaabo y'okuheereza. Omu ishomero, ekikundi ky'abegyi kigambira omwegyesa: "Tikirikubaasika kutebeekanisa omuheereza ogurikugumaho buzima ahabw'okuba ekirikwetagisa n'okugeza kwongyera kukendeeza okukoresa eby'obutonde nk'oku kiraabe kisoboka, hati omu mbeera egi, ekirikukiraho obulungi n'obutakora muheereza." Ni ki ekishoboorora ekirikukiraho obuhikire kushoboorora, n'obuhangwa obuhikire n'orurimi orurikwata aha byona, ebigambo by'abegyi?
answer_a: Embeera z'obuhunguzi nizo ezirikukikora ngu abantu babeho omu nsi obuzaire bwabo butarikwongyera, kandi embeera ezi zirikubaasa kuhikiirira twaba tutarikwongyera abantu n'eby'obushubuzi bitarikukura nari itunga ly'eihanga ritarikwongyera.
answer_b: Embeera y'enkuraakulana erambirire neeyoreka omu kukora n'obwegendereza n'obuhangwa oburikukiraho obwenganga n'obwomeezi, obutabumara kandi bukagumizibwa ebyemirembe egiirikwija, hatariho kuremesa omuntu weena kutunga ebiri omu byo.
answer_c: Obuhungiro nikwo embeera y’amagara ahu ebi abantu baroota birikukorwa haine kutaata omutindo gw’obutonde bw’ensi. Eki nikimanyisa ngu ebi turikukora hati bishemereire kutureetera kukwatana n’obutonde bw’ensi kandi ngu ebi abantu baroota bigumeho omu bwire bwona.
answer_d: Okukomaho nikikumanyisa obushoboorozi bw'enkora y'ensi obw'okushagika okukura kw'abantu, ekirikugambira kimwe ngu enteekateeka y'eby'obushangwa eshemereire kuguma omu rubibi rw'obushoboorozi bw'ensi, okwetegyereza okukomaho nk'okukura hatariho kwongyera.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi omu yaabaire asaba abegyirwa be ab’omu mashomero ga hagati kushwijuma omukora gw’obuheereza bwabo kurugiirira aha muringo eki bareetsireho kyakomereireho ekyetengo eki baahandiikireho omu kutandika kw’omushinga. Abaana baashwijuma ebirugiremu, bakareeba ngu abakoresa baabo tibarikukuratira ngu eki baabaire nibenda kukora kikomereireho oburemeezi bwabo obw’okubanza, reero tibarikukora nk’oku omwegyesi yaabaire abategire. Aha bikurikurataho, niki ekirikukiraho kuba kirungi kukora nk’omwegyesi kushobora kwihaho oburemeezi obu abegyirwa barikugyenda nibarabamu omu kukora omushinga gwabo?
answer_a: Baha obuhabuzi bw'okuheereza omukozesa, oburikumuheereza obushoboorozi bw'okwetegyereza ebintu ebi omurimo ogu gurikukora gye:
answer_b: Shaba obagambire bakore okucwekyereza amakuru agatairweho, ahabw’okushuuruura n’okurungyiiriza ebicweka ebi bitarikukwanisa n’enkura y’omurimo ogu.
answer_c: Mubagambe engyenderwaho z'okuhindura omuhendo ogu murikugaba, kandi mubasabe okucwekyereza butoosha aha byetengo by'abakozesa.
answer_d: Baha kureetera empindahinduka nungi omu purojekiti yaabo kandi obagambire bagyende beebuuze abakoresa omurundi ogundi, nibakuratira omumyanya egi etarikutunguuka gye omu purojekiti yaabo.

question: Omu omutwe gw'ekicweka "Okuhwereza hamwe n'Omucuruzi", abegi b'omwaka gw'okubanza owa Secondary nibakora aha kutebeekaniza omushinga. Omu mbeera egi, ekikundi kicumura kwombeka ebintu ebirundaaniza amaizi g'enkuba kugira ngu bagyegyezese. Nibatebeekaniza kukora okushwijuma, bwanyima batebeekanize ebintu ebi kurugiira aha bwingi bw'amaizi abu barikubaasa kurundaaniza. Bwanyima baryashoborora omwanya abu baryabiteeka n'ebikoresho ebyetengwa. Kandi baryatebeekaniza ekicweka kya Gantt n'ebyetengo ebirikukwatana n'omushinga ogwo. Kurugiira aha kwega n'omuringo ogurikukoresibwa, oburemeezi ki oburikworekwa omu kutebeekaniza omushinga ogukozirwe abegi?
answer_a: Eky'okushaba ekyaba kiri omu mushonga tikirikukwata aha kizibu nari obutakamilika ebyaba bimanyirwe abeeshure ab'enyima
answer_b: Omuringo ogurikukwatwa omu purojekiti tigurikubamu obushoborozi bw’ebikorwa ebi abeeshuri barikukora omu buri mutendera gw’epurojekiti.
answer_c: Ekyeshongore eki kyaba kigambwaho omu purojekiti tikirikushoborora ebintu by'obuhanga abeeshuri abaine kukuraho omutima omu kuzoora ebyombeko by'amazzi g'enkuba.
answer_d: Eky'okushaba ekirikukwata aha purojekiti tikirikuteekateeka ngu abeeshure bagyeragyeranise empango z'ebintu ebirikuteekwa amazzi g'enkuba ebirikugurwa omu katale bataka kureeba oku barikwenda kukora ezaabo.

question: Omu omukuru w’ekicweka ky’eshomero eyaali omwaka ogw’okubanza, bwamara kurangiiza enteekateeka y’okuhanga ebintu by’obuhangwa n’abeeshuri, omugyezibwa abagambira kucweera omutindo gw’emirimo, egyabo n’egyabanywani baabo, nibakoresa emisingi y’obuhangwa n’omugasho, kubaasa kumanya yaaba okuhindura nikwetagisa. Eki nikigira ngu, nibaija kuhaburwa eky’okukurata omu kucweera obwire bw’okubaanjura emirimo. Noorekire aha misingi egambirwe, ni birikwereka ki ebirikubaasa kwongyerwa omu kiragiro ky’okucweera eki abeeshuri baraakuratize?
answer_a: Nibarikira kandi baronda ebiteekateeko by'okutunguura ebintu bya tekinoloji, omu omwe n'omukago.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza kurengyesereza omu bintu ebi beezimbire n’ebi abandi baazimbire kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by’okutungaaza ebi baaba baayetegura.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza ebintu ebyezimbirwe nari eby'abandi kureeba yaaba nibireeta obuteerwa omu kukora kwabyo
answer_d: Nibarikiriza ebintu ebyezimbirwe, nibashisha obuhikire bw'ebikozesebwa n'emitwarize yabyo nk'oku kirikwetegwa.

question:
Omu mutwe gw'okukoresa obutungi oburikukora, kuruga omu mwaka gwakabiri gw'eshomero erikuru, ekikundi ky'abanyeshuri nikiteekateeka okuhanga akatabo k'obuhabuzi n'emitindo erikuhwera amaka agatoorainwe kuruga omu bantu b'omukago gw'eby'oburezi kucweekereza eby'omutaano n'okukozesa obutungi nk'amaizi, ggaasi, n'amashanyarazi, reero bakakora okukyerereza kureeba yaaba emitindo ei bateekateeka neegasa.
Ni muringo ki gw'ebikorwa ebi abanyeshuri bakozeseze ogurikworeka ngu nibashobora kucweekereza eby'entaano by'omutaano ogu bateekateeka?
answer_a: Abeshomesha niboherereza ab’eka yoona eky’okubuuza ekirikukorwa omukuraani (online) orubaju rumwe bwabaireho kuhayo akatabo k’ebirikukora, nibabuuza ebiteekateeko ebikakozeseibwe omu maka gaabo, oburemeezi obu baraabe bahikireho, hamwe n’ebirikubaasa kwemerwa nk’emiziizo.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibashaba ab’eka ebitabo byabo by’okubanza by’omutaano, bwanyima babaha akatabo k’obuhabuzi. Bwanyima y’omwezi, nibashaba ekitabo ky’omutaano ekindi kugyeragyeranisa ebirugiremu. N’ebyo ebirugiremu, nibashwijuma omugasho gw’ebyo barikukora.
answer_c: Eizooba erizooba rimwe bwamara kuhayo akatabo k'obuhabuzi, abeeshuri nibakora ebibuuzo n'ab'omu maka, nibababuza aha mbeera ya buri omwe omu maka n'oku bakozeseze emiringo ei barikwenda kugarura omu mwanya. Kuruga aho, nibashoborora ebirugiremu by'eby'obushomesha ebyataireho.
answer_d: Abeshuri kubaha ekitabo ky'obuhabuzi, abeeshuri nibabuuza ab'eka: Mbeera ki ezirikuba zirikureetera okukoresa eby'obugaiga bingi omu maka gaanyu? Omwezi gumwe bwabaireho nibahaireyo ekitabo ky'obuhabuzi, nibagaruka babuuza: Ni mirembe ki eyaheerize eyaabahaire obuyambi kukendeeza aha matungo?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’okubanza omuishomero erikuru ari kukora aha mutwe “Ekyarikuruga omu kucweera hamu n’omugasho gwakyo”. Aha muheru gw’omutwe, omwegyesa naija kushwijuma ekigyendererwa eki: “Kushwijuma omu muringo ebintu by’eteknologi n’obushangwa bw’abantu birikukura kuraba omu kumanya ebintu ebirikukora aha enkyukakyuka egi.” Ni ebintu ki ebirikukurugiraho nibyo birikwija kureetera omwegyesa kushwijuma omulingo ekigyendererwa eki kirikukorwa?
answer_a: Gyenda obuuze abeeshuri kushoborora oku entunguuka y'eby'obuhangwa erikukwata aha bantu n'obusingye bw'obutonde omu bwire n'omu mwanya ogurikwenda.
answer_b: Shaba abeeshuri kubaza kwatura emitwarize ey'obushomi egiireho omu myaka 50 ehiherire n'okwerekana empinduka eziyeteengyeseze eby'obuhanga obw'omulembe.
answer_c: Shaba abeeshuri batoorane kandi bashoboorore eky'okureeberaho kirikukwata aha, omutaano gw'eby'obuhangwa bw'omulembe ogukuzireho omu bwire oburikuhindura embeera y'abantu omu butoosha.
answer_d: Mubuuze abeeshuli, kurugiira aha kubuuza abu mwahikanire nabo omu bitundu ebi mwashomire, kumanya ebintu, emiringo, nari obuhanga obuhindwire, kandi mwoleke ebintu ebyagizireho amaani omu kuhinduka oku.

question:
Omuhwezi w’eky’omugasho omu kicweka kya 10, omwegyesa ari kukora n’abegyi aha kigyendererwa ekirikukurataho: “Kwetegyereza entandikiro n’omugasho gw’ebirikureeta obucafu omu mwanya.” Nk’omurimo, omwegyesa nagira abegyi bakore omu bibinja kushwijuma obucafu obwo n’omugasho gwabwo, kandi bateekanize olutaro orwa PowerPoint n’amajanja guboona. Ebi bibinja byaba nibireeta emirimo yabyo, omwegyesa naataho omutima ngu abegyi abarikukira obwingi nibamara ngu obucafu oburikureeta obucafu omu mwanya nibwo oburikukorwa abantu.
Ni ki aha bigambo ebi omwegyesa araakugambe ekirikukwatanisa n’okuhabura abegyi kugira ngu bongyereho emirimo yaabo kandi bahikiirize ekigyendererwa?
answer_a: Kurungi munonga, werekire ekyoleka ngu ebikorwa by'abantu biine omugisha mubi munonga aha bwengye. Kwonka, n'obundi bwoko ki obw'ebintu ebirikuhumbya obwengye oburiho obutari bugyendera aha bikorwa by'abantu? Migisha ki ey'obwo bwoko bw'ebintu ebirikuhumbya obwengye?
answer_b: Murabyo gye wayorekaine omu kworeka kwaawe, okagambire ngu twena nitutwarwa omu mwonga gw'omwuka oguhumire. Ekirikushigara kukora n'okuhikiiriza okucuurana oku orikugarukamu ebimashine ebirikukora nibyo bitandika omwonga gw'omwuka oguhumire? Noobaasa kuteeka ota aha kutegyereza oburemeezi bw'ebyo birikurugaamu?
answer_c: Murungi, obaire kukora gye, obamanyire ngu amafuta g'ebitare gye nshuro y'omwanda omu mwika ahabw'okukoresibwa munonga omu bikorwa by'abantu bitari bimwe. Kwonka, nooteekateeka ngu niki ekirikubaasa kuba enshonga y'amaani aha butonde n'abantu ahabw'okukoresa amafuta g'ebitare aga? Ni bata ki enshonga ezi zirikutegyerezibwa kugyezibwa?
answer_d: Ninkusiima, okabaasa kushuuruura oburemeezi bw’omwika gwa carbon monoxide nk’omutaano omukuru omu mwika oguhumuurwa. Kwonka oshemereire kubuuza n’ekibuuzo eki: emigabo mingaha ey’omwika gwa carbon monoxide eruga omu motoka z’abantu bonka egiira omu kutaana omwika oguhumuurwa? Nitubaasa kugira emigabo mingaha omu kukendeeza omuze ogu twakozesa eby’entambura bya rubanda?

question: Omwegyesi w’eisomero ry’abato aryashwijuma akabonero aka kuruga omu Kuteegyeka Okukuru kw’Obutonde bw’Emihango n’Enzikiriza: Akoresa ebikoreso by’omu ka n’eby’omutegyeki omu mbeera za burijo n’emizano. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira ezirikubaasa kukozesebwa kukora obuhame bw’akabonero aka?
answer_a: Omu mwanya gw'ebyokurya, teeka ebikozesebwa nk'obucumu n'etamaara omu byombo eby'enjawulo; kandi omu bwire bw'okulya, ohandiike abaana obu baragizibwe kugaba ebi bintu.
answer_b: Omu kicweka ky'okubaka, haayo eby'okubikamu n'ebintu ebirikukoresibwa eby'emiringo n'obunene obutari bumwe; kandi omu bwire bw'okuzana, ohandiike emigongo y'ebintu abaana abarikwombeka nibakoresa ebintu ebi.
answer_c: Omuhanda gw'eka, yongyeramu ebintu bisya nk'ebikapu, eby'okutwara ebbaruha, n'ebintu by'omu ofiisi; kandi omu mizaano, oreekoodinga emirimo abaana ei barikukora n'ebyo bintu.
answer_d: Omuhanda gw'okushushaniiramu, haayo ebintu bitari bimwe omu kasanduku k'omuceeri nk'ebikopo, obucupa, n'emigwe; kandi omu bwire bw'okushushana, oreekodi ebi abaana barikukora obu barikwetwa eky'okukoresa kandi barikushabwa kukibeka omu kabati kakuhurira.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omu mashomero g’ahaiguru owa mwaka gw’akabiri, naagira abegi be kutunga omugisha gw’okukora purojekiti erikukoresa obutungi bw’amaani omu izooba eryo omu muringo murungi. Omu kuza omu maisho n’omurimo ogwo, naahurira ekibiina ky’abegi nibagamba aha kintu eki baraateeraho amaani omu purojekiti egi: abamwe nibenda okukora aha by’okukyuusa empapura, abandi nibenda okukora aha kwetantaza amashanyarazi, na munonga omu byumba by’okwegyeramu. Omugyezibwa naareeba ngu ebi barikwenda bikora tibirikwetenga omu purojekiti egi. Omu bintu ebi omugyezibwa arikubaasa kukora, eki kiri kukwasa abegi kumanya ekigyendererwa ky’omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Yoreka abegyeshuri eby'okureeberaho by'okukoresa ebintu ebirikukozesa amaani g'omuriro gye, nk'omuriro gwa LED
answer_b: Shoborora abeshomesha emigasho n'obubi bw'okukoresa obutare bw'amaani obwa burijo n'obutari bwa burijo omu kuhingura amashanyarazi.
answer_c: Yombeka n'abeeshure omumeza gw'entaaniso n'eby'okureeberaho by'obutaagi bw'ebintu n'amaani, orikushoboorora ngu okukoresa amaani gye nikikwata aha izooba erya nyuma.
answer_d: Hamutora hamwe n'abeeshuri, omugasho gw'amaani n'oburyo turikugikoresa omu mbeera ezirikumanyisa omutaano oguri ahagati y'okukuumira n'okukoresa amaani omu buringaniza.

question: Omugyezibwa omuhiga omu mwaka gwa 1 ogw'eshomero erikuru naashaba abegi be kwetebeekanisiza ekicweka kya Gantt okutebeekanisa obuhereza bwaba nibenda kukora omu itendekyero. Omu kubutebeekanisa, omugyezibwa naayoleka ngu abegi tibarikubara gye obwire bwabaasa kutwaara kukora buri kimwe aha mirimo kandi, n'ahabw'ekyo, tibarikubaasa kuhikiiriza okwetebeekanisiza okukora obuhereza omu bwire. Ni enki aha bintu ebi omugyezibwa araakore eky'okuza kureka abegi kugarukira aha murimo gwabo kuhikiiriza omurimo ogwo ogushabirwe?
answer_a: Yoreke abeeshuri eky'okureeberaho ky'omurimo ogwa buri izooba ogurikwetagisa kuteekateeka aha bunaku obu kirikutwara kukora ogurikukurataho
answer_b: Shaba abeeshuri kuteekateeka ekigyendererwa ky'omushinga gwabo, kandi kuruga aharikyo, bakuratane entambwe zoona ezirikubaasa kubahitsya aha kukora omurimo ogwo.
answer_c: Yoreeke abeeshuri embeera y'okuteebereza ahu abantu abakuru barikuba batarikubaasa kukora omurimo ahabw'okuba batakozire ogundi ogurikwetagisa kubanza kukorwa.
answer_d: Hamwe n'abanyeshuri, mukore okucweeka obutegyeki bw'emirimo eshohoire, mugihurikize n'obwire oburaheebwe, kandi mushuuruure yaaba obwo obwire nibuhikire.

question: Omu omwegyesa omu kiraasi ey'omwaka ogw'okubanza omu secondary, arikugyenda n'ekigendererwa eki: "Kumanya ebyetengo nari emigisha omu izooba, ebirikwetenga okuhanga omurimo kurabira omu kukungaana, kutebeekanisa, n'okushoborora amakuru agataireho okushaba enyegyesa ezirikukwatanisa," omwegyesa ateekateeka kukoresa ebikoreso bitari bimwe n'abeeshuri be nk'okubuuza abantu, emeeza z'amakuru, n'ebishushani, aha bandi, kukungaana n'okutebeekanisa amakuru. Aha isomo ery'okubanza, omwegyesa aine ekigendererwa ky'okuhiga n'okufata omutima gw'abeeshuri kurabira omu kwoleka omulingo gwona ogw'okukungaana amakuru ogu abeeshuri be barikwija kukora. Omu bintu ebi ebiri ahansi, ekikoreso ki ekirikukwata aha kwegyesa ekirikukwata omwegyesa kukoresa omu isomo ery'okubanza, twarikureeba ekigendererwa ekirugambwaho n'obugumu bw'omulingo ogu arikwija kwoleka?
answer_a: Orutindo rw’omukura, orurikworeka ebikorwa by’okubangaanisa hamwe n’okukorera hamwe omu kuzoora ebikoreso, n’okushwijuma n’okushoboorora ebirugiremu kurugiirira aha meza n’obushushani.
answer_b: Ekishushani ky'omuryango, ekirikworeka obwire obutari bumwe n'omukago oguri hagati y'emirimo egirikwetagisa omu kuzooka n'okukoresa ebikorwa, n'okushwijuma ebirugiremu kurugiira aha meza n'ebishushani.
answer_c: Omurongo gw'okworeka (PowerPoint presentation) ogurikworeka emigari y'ebikoresho ebirikukoresibwa kukora data, emitwarize yaabyo, emisingi mikuru y'okubyombeka, n'eby'okureeberaho by'okutebeekanisa data omu meza n'omubarafu (graphs)
answer_d: Vidiyo y’okwegyesa, erikushoboorora omuringo gw’okukora n’okukoresa ebikoreso by’okucweeka amakuru omu mbeera y’embabazi, reero n’omuringo orikubaasika okushoboorora amakuru aga kurugiirira aha meza n’ebishushani.

question: Omu omutwe gw'okukura n'okutaho omurimo omu kiraasi y'omwaka gw'okubanza omu mashomero agakuraho, omwegyesa ari kutandika kukoragana n'abegyeswa be aha kutebeekanisa emirimo y'omukago ey'ekisomesa. Eki, ekigyendererwa kyabo ekya kubanza eki barikwija kukurataho ni: "Kwetegyereza ebyetengo n'omugisha ogurikwetenga okutaho omurimo". Murongo ki gw'ebikorwa omwegyesa ashemereire kukoragana n'abegyeswa be kukuratira ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naayoreka omulingo gw'obukuru n'omulingo gw'okuheereza, ahe n'eby'okureeberaho by'emilingo egi yoona. Eky'okurugaaho, naabuuza abeeshuri kushoboorora n'okutaho omu mitwaro emiringo y'okuheereza erikushushana, kurugiirira aha mugasho ogu erikukikora.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naayoreka enshonga z'obwetago ezabaho omu bwire obw'ebyafaayo obutari bumwe kandi ezakumirirwe kuraba omu murimo ogurikukorwa. Ekyakurataho, abagambira kucwekyereza enshonga ezareeteire emirimo ebiri emisya egy'omulembe gw'ekyana kya makumi abiri na gumwe.
answer_c: Omugyezibwa naabuuza abeeshuri eki barikumanya aha bwetaago. Bahandiika amakuru aga butoosha agu baraabe bahikiireho. Bwanyima, baha eby'okureeberaho, baabuuza abeeshuri kugishura omu bibinja ebi ebimwe ebi ebirikubaasa kucungurwa ekikorwa ky'eby'obuhangwa. Ku baraamara okuhikiiriza oruteerane, nibaha oburyo bumwe obw'okumanya embeera z'obwetaago.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naagyerera abegi amakuru g'ekintu ekiine kubahitsya, kandi n'abaha eby'okureeberaho. Bwanyima, n'abagambira kukora okucwekyereza aha mirimo eriyo omu magomero gaabo. N'abasaba kwetebeekanisiza omurimo omu ishomero eririkukurataho, omubarikwija kugarukamu emirimo n'okushoboorora omuringo egirikumaraho ebizibu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa ssenyende ey'okubanza owa siniya ari kukora aha mutwe "Emirimo y'Obuheemura omu Siniya yaitu". Omu masomo g'okubanza, abegyeswa bakozeseze kandi bakora okubuza abantu okutunga amakuru ahari ebyetengo by'omuriitaka kandi bashanga ebyetengo bishatu: 1) tihariho muringo gw'okutunga eby'okurya birungi omu siniya; 2) tihariho senta y'obuhabuzi bw'obuhangwa bwingi; kandi 3) ebyanya by'eishomero tibirikukwana kwemerera emizaano etari emwe. Bwanyima y'okutoorana ekyetengo, omwegyesa naija kukora omurimo abegyeswa be barikwenda okuteeraho eby'okugaruraho, kandi bagambe ahabw'omugasho gwabyo. Omu mirimo egi erikukuraho n'enungi omwegyesa kuteeraho abegyeswa be kubaasa kukuraaza omuringo gw'okutoorana n'okuhakanira eky'okugaruraho?
answer_a: Kutebeekanisa abeeshuli omuringo gw'okumaraho oburemeezi obwabireho, kurugiirira aha byetengo ebimwe ebyashangwa, kubahabura omu muringo gw'okutebeekanisa n'okukora omuti gw'oburemeezi.
answer_b: Kukora okwetegyereza hamwe n'abeeshuri abaine ebyetengo bitari bimwe n'okubangira akachati k'okugyeragyeranisa ebyetengo byabo n'obuhereza n'oburyo bw'okumaraho ebizibu ebi bikwatagaine nabyo, omu mbeera y'eby'obushubuzi n'emiramizo efaanaine
answer_c: Kukora omurimo, hamwe n'abeshomesa, okushoborora n'okwetegyereza oburemeezi kurugiirira aha kimwe aha byetengo ebyashangwa omu ishomo, no kubashaba kuteeka omu biteekateeko by'okumaraho oburemeezi obwo, nibahakanira ebi bacwire.
answer_d: Kuganiira n'abeeshuri obukuru bw'okucwamu ekizibu kimwe ahari ebyo ebyakungaaniziibwe, nikitsiigatiira obukuru bw'ekyo omu kutebeekanisa engyenderwaho ezirikubaasa kukorwa.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi owa secondary omu omwaka ogw'okubanza, omu mutwe "Okukura n'Okutekaho omu nkora Obuheereza bw'Eby'omuburingaaniza", abagambire abegyesi kukora emirimo erikukwata aha bwetaati oburikumanywa omu ishomero. Okutandika omurimo, abegyesi bakashoborora obwetaati bw'okumanya ebintu ebiteirwe omu Orubaju rw'Obuhanga, kubaasa kugyaho ebi batarikukoresa ahabw'okuba bikataireho kandi byahwereera. Hanyuma, baragirwe omwegyesi, baganira aha miringo erikubaasa kukoresibwa kwetantara oburemeezi bw'okusaanya ebintu, kandi bacwamu kukora ebarizo ry'eby'omuburingaaniza. Ekyakurataho, kubaasa kutebeekanisa omuringo gwabo bw'okumaraho oburemeezi, baketegyereza application ezirikubaasa kukora ebarizo. Kubaasa kworeka entebeekanisa yabo y'obuheereza nibakoresa ebikoreso bya ICT, bumanyi ki oburikwetagisa abegyesi kuba barakabataireho?
answer_a: Kumanya omuringo gw'okuhurira omutaagi gw'eby'omubucwezi n'ekizibu ekyamanyirwe.
answer_b: Kureebera eby'omugasho bya kompyuta omu kubaanza kuhindura ebishushani n'ebyahandiikwa
answer_c: Kumanya orurimi rw'omusingye orwa puroguraamu rurikukwasisa kukora apulikasiyo
answer_d: Kumanya oku orikukoresa programu za kompyuta kukora ebishushani by'obuhanga omu buringanire bw'obureezi bubiri n'obureezi bushatu (2D na 3D)

question: Omugyezaho omu omwaka gwa kabiri omu mashuuri gaa sekenda arikukorera hamwe n'abegi be aha biteekateeko by'okuhindahindura obuto obuto n'okuhindura munonga nari okucwekyereza. Nk'omuringo gw'okubanza, omugyezaho n'aha abegi eby'okureeberaho by'emitwarize yombi y'okuhindahindura kandi abashaba kushwijuma n'okubiteeka omu bibinja, nibahakanira aha bicweka byabo. Ku araabe naashwijuma omurimo gw'abegi, naareeba ngu ekibiina kimwe kiteekire esimu erikwingaanwa (erikwingaanwa) nk'okuhindura okucwekyereza, nibahakanira ngu omutaano ogu omu simu n'ekintu kipya kimwe. Kwihaho okutahurira ki okurikubaasa kureebwa kuruga omu kugarukwamu kw'ekibiina eki ky'abegi?
answer_a: Kuteekateeka obuhanga bw'okuhindura nk'okukora enyenzereza aha kintu kimwe ekirikwetegyereza
answer_b: Kuhuura obuhanga bw'amaani n'ebintu ebiriyo obu obuhinguzi buriho rundi obw'omulembe ogurikukura.
answer_c: Kugira ngu otware ngu obuhanga bw'okuhindura nibuhikire aha mpinduka omu muringo gw'ekintu kyonka
answer_d: Kwetegyereza obuhanga bw'omutaano nk'okutongooza okuhindura omu muhendo ogu ekintu kirimu.

question: Ekibiina ky'abeeshomo omwaka ogw'okubanza kyakora omurimo gw'okugarura ebintu ebyabura omu ishomo lyabo. Ekirikukiraho omu murimo gwabo n'okugira ngu ku baraabe nibagarura ekintu, nibafaayo munonga kukwata omuntu orikukwatwaho n'ekintu eki, kandi bakakimuhereza omu bwihisho, kugira ngu batarugwaho ebigambo nari okushinjwa okutari kw'amazima. Omu bintu ebiri ahansi, nikirikubaasa kurora yaaba abeeshomo bakakora omurimo gwabo omu muringo murungi, nibakuratira emisingi y'obuhangwa?
answer_a: Nibateekateeka aha bukuru bw'okukuratira obuteegyeki n'obuteekaniza bw'abantu omu kuzooba ebirikukora.
answer_b: Nibarikira omuringo gwabo gw'okumaraho ekizibu kureeba yaaba niguhikiiriza ebi abakozesa barikwenda n'obucureezi n'obuteekaniza bw'eby'okukoresa ebyo.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza oburinganiza bw’okureeberera okukora emirimo omu muringo ogurikugumisiriza oburemeezi n’ekihungo ky’abantu.
answer_d: Nibarikora omurimo nk'oku orutebe rurikumanyisa, nibakikora nibareeba ngu abarikukoresa omurimo ogwo nibarindwa kandi batekanirwe.

question: Omwegyesi w’omu secondary owa klasse ya 2, omu mutwe gw’eky’okwegera “Ebiita by’abantu aha butonde bw’ensi”, abaire ashabire abegyereza be kukora okunoonyereza hamwe aha bintu ebiri kureeta obucafu bw’omwanya oburikukwatana n’okukora ebintu bingi n’okubikozesa bingi, n’ebirikurugamu omu bunaku obu n’omu bunaku oburi haihi. Aha muheru gw’omurimo ogu, omwegyesi naashaba abegyereza be kuteera hamwe ebirugiremu by’okunoonyereza kwabo kuraba omu kuteeraho ebiri kureeta obucafu n’ebirikurugamu, n’okuteeraho ebintu ebirikubaasa kukorwa omu bunaku obu n’omu bunaku oburi haihi kugyerereza ebiita ebi. Nkahi kantu k’okushomesereza nikyo kirikwija kukonyera omwegyesi kushomesereza omurimo ogukozirwe ekikundi ky’abegyereza?
answer_a: Omutemwa gw'ebikorwa
answer_b: Ebirikurinda
answer_c: Omugisha gw'okushomesa
answer_d: Ekitabo ky'omwegi

question: Abanyeshuri ab’omumwaka ogw’okubanza omu mashomero g’ahaiguru bakozire enyikiriza zaabo z’okubanza ez’ebishushani by’emikutu (apps) ez’ebintu ebirikushobororwa omu muringo gw’ebishushani ebirikukozesibwa omukono, nk’ebishushani-ngango. Nibaija kwimurira ebishushani ebi omu muringo gw’ekikoompyuta ogurikubasiisa kukora n’enyandika, emigongo y’ebyahandiikwa, kuhindura obunene n’emyanya y’ebishushani, amarangirizi omu baruha, enyima n’emitero, kuteekamu ebishushani ebirikutaagurwa hamwe n’oburemeezi bw’amaisho n’ebirikuhinduka. Ni kikoreso ki kya ICT ekirikwija kubasiisa abanyeshuri kukora omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Kofta y’okworeka erikukwasa kworeka ebyahandiikwa n’ebishushani aha slaaidi ez’omutaano
answer_b: Ekikoreso ky’okuhandiika ebigambo omuri kompyuta ekirikubaasa kutebeekanisa ebigambo n’ebishushani aha mpapura ezirikushaanisa
answer_c: Ekikoreso ky'omukura ogurikukora aha interneti ekirikukwemerera kuta omubusaati n'ebyahandiikwa kandi kirimuhendo.
answer_d: Omukura gw'aha mukura ogurikukwemerera kuhanga n'okuhindura ebishushani n'ebyahandiikwa orikurugiirira aha ntebeekanisa ez'omutaano

question: Omuhendo gwahaansi aha mirimo y'okwohereza enyehurira z'obwengye niguha abaana omugisha murungi okukuza obuhangwa?
answer_a: Okushushaniisa ekishushani ky'omuringo gw'ekiteeteeyi (mandala) orikukoresa amarangi g'amaizi
answer_b: Okukata ebishushani norikukoresa amapapura agariyoona gariyoona
answer_c: Okukora omuti ogurikureebwa kuruga omu rurembo orurikumarirwamu orutindo norukoresa ebumba
answer_d: Okuteiba empapura z'amara omu miringo etari emwe emwe

question:
Omu mwaka gutandika, abeeshure omu ishomero nibashabwa kuhayo orubazo rw'edakiika 2 aha bi baakozire omu bwiire bw'ekyanda. Paula, omwishiki orikusonya n'okuceeceera, naateegyereza omurundi gwe okugamba. Ku arikukora eki, omutima gwe gutandika kukuba munoonga, ebiganja bye bitandika kubira enjoka n'enda ye neegwa omu kantu. Omwegyesa we ku amwetera omu maisho Paula yaatandika kugamba, agumirwa kwijuka eki arikwenda kugamba n'engaro ze zaatandika kutentema.

Omu mbeera eyo, niki ekirikubaasa kuteebwa kurungi kuruga aha nshemeziro za Paula n'emitwarize ye?
answer_a: Omutima gwe nigwo gukora nk'eky'okucungira nigwo guri haihi.
answer_b: Omutima gwe nigwo gukora gye
answer_c: Aineenyerwa kugaamba aha biro by'oruhooro rwe.
answer_d: Obwahati ashangire kuba aine ekizibu ekirikumutwara.

question: Okurikugyenderwaho eky'omugambi gwa Bowlby, ni ndyahi aha bigambo ebi erikuhikaana n'ekirikworeka omutwarize gw'okugyenderaana?
answer_a: N'omuringo ogurikumara okuhitsya omu myaka y'obuto bw'omuntu
answer_b: Ni omukago ogushemereire kuguma guriho kandi ogutahwamu, kubaasa kuhwera omwana kukura omu muringo oguhikire.
answer_c: Omugashani nigwo gurikushobora kumanya omukago gwona ogurikukwata aha mukura gw'obwomeezi n'enkura y'omuntu.
answer_d: Buhikye bwa iraangiro obw'omwana omuhya n'omunyeeneka we kandi tiburikubaasa kutaangwa omuntu ondiijo

question: Shoma eky’okureeberaho eki: Omwegyesa natandika kukora aha kumanyisa enamba kwongyera obureezi bw’okubara omu baana abato. Nk’omurimo gw’okubanza, nayenda abaana abashaija n’abashiki kukubaasa kumanya enamba 1. Ahabw’okumanya kwe ebirikukwata aha mutindo gwabo, naamanya ngu Vicente ni omwana orikukora munonga, orikwega gye arikukoresa omubiri gwe, n’ahabw’ekyo aza kumushaba kwegyerera enamba 1. Aha rundi ruriku, naamanya ngu Martina na Clemente baine obureezi bwingi omu by’okuririmba kandi nibega bwangu kuraba omu ndirimbo, n’ahabw’ekyo aza kubishobekereza omu by’arikuza kukora. Ni muguzo ki gw’omusingi gw’okwegyesa abaana abato ogurikukirayo kworekwa omu kutebeekanisa kw’omwegyesa ogu?
answer_a: Okugumya
answer_b: Obumwe bw'omutaano
answer_c: Omukago
answer_d: Okushamba

question: Ni eni omuhendo gwaha ebimurikira okukura kw'obwomeezi omu bahungu n'abashiki abarikutandika omutendera gw'okuteekateeka batarikukozesa muringo?
answer_a: Okukoresa okuteekateeka kw'akabonero
answer_b: Okushobora kucwamu ebirikukurataho kuruga omu bintu ebirikugambwaho
answer_c: Okukoresa okuteekateeka kw'okuhakanisa
answer_d: Okukora omukutano n'obusingye bw'obutonde bwona kuraba omu mizano y'okugezesereza

question: Teekateekateeka embeera egi: Omwegyesa omuhyaka aine emisiri ebiri y'ebirikisi erimu emiringaaniza, kwonka ogumu aha misiri nigwojoreka nk'ogurikuruha ahabw'okuba ebirikisi nibitangataanisibwe. Omwe aha baana aija aha mwegyesa yaagira ati, 'Muka, ogu omusiri guine ebirikisi bingi okukira ogundi.' Okurikira omugambi gwa J. Piaget, niki ekirikwoleka omulingo gw'okuteekateeka ogurikworekwa omu kyakozire omwana?
answer_a: Okukwata aha kintu kimwe
answer_b: Okutaanisa enzikiriza
answer_c: Okuhindura
answer_d: Kutagaruka

question: Omwana, arikugyenda na ishe omu mbura, areeba omu iguru yaayorekyeza ebicu, naagira ati: 'Ebicu nibihĩĩire, nikyo birikurira.' Okurikira enyegyesa ya Jean Piaget y'okuteekateeka, niki ekirikworeka omuringo gw'okuteekateeka ogurikworekwa omu bigambo by'omwana?
answer_a: Obuhangwa bw'ebintu byoona
answer_b: Okutaanisa enzikiriza
answer_c: Obuhangahanga
answer_d: Emyemerero

question: Shoma ebirikukurataho: Ni bw'omutindo gw'okushamba ogw'okubanza omu bantu. Nibazannya emizaano omuntu omweirikwatanisa eby'okwehanangiriza omubiri omurundi ogwingi. Omutaano ki ogurikukwatanisa n'ekishoboorora eki?
answer_b: Ky'okubonabona
answer_c: Ekirikukora
answer_d: Omuringaniza

question: Ni buhinguriro ki obukuru obukuzibwa omu baana kurabira omu mizaano erimu entebeekanisa?
answer_a: Okushushaanisa embeera ez'obuhangwa nk'ebishushani
answer_b: Okuteeka omutima omu omukyeendi n'okumaraho enkaiko
answer_c: Okugambisania ebintu ebirikukirizibwa hamu n'oburyo bwo kubihindura
answer_d: Okwegyesa emicwe n'ebikorwa ebyashingirweho omu mbeera z'obuhangwa

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurira:
Patricia, omwegyesa w'abaana abato, atumira abaana bataano kuruga omu kiraasi ye buri sande kwegyemereza omurimo gw'akagulu k'abaana bato.
Nagambira abaana ngu omwebembezi naija kuteekateeka omuzano gw'akagulu kandi ahiga banywani be kukuratira amateeka g'omuzano ogwo oguteekateikirwe.
Kurugiirira aha byiciro bya Erikson eby'okukura kw'embeera z'obuntu, ekirikwoleka omu kumanya okwo okwabaireho nikyo ki?
answer_a: Okugyemesereza n'okugira enshonga y'okwehurira omubi
answer_b: Okugyenga n'okutagyenga
answer_c: Obushoboorozi n'okutaho omutima vs. okwehurira nk'otarikumara
answer_d: Obwesigye omu bwomeezi bw'omuntu kuruga omu kuswazibwa n'okutekaniriza

question: Omuhurikiizi omu bato, abashaija n'abakazi niboora ebishushani n'ekyanga aha kibanja ky'eishomero. Fabián nagambira omwegyesa ngu tinyenda kuboora ahabw'okuba ekyanga ky'omubaara nikyo kishigireho kandi omubaara n'erangi y'abakazi. Omwegyesa naamugambira ngu erangi n'eya buri omwe, tikuri y'abashaija nari abakazi bonka, kandi ashemereire kugezaho kuboora nayo nk'oku ababozi bakora. Omu bukwatane n'emiringo, niki ekicweka eky'okuteekateeka eki omwegyesa atandiiiseho kirikukwasa omwana kukura?
answer_a: Okukunda omuntu omwe nk'oku ari
answer_b: Okwetegyereza omuntu nk'oku ari
answer_c: Obumwe bw'omuntu omuhendo.
answer_d: Omwetarikirwa gw'omuringo gw'okwetwara nk'omushaija nari omukazi

question: Teekateekateeka embeera egi: Omwegyesa omu omuto omu myaka y'abaana abato atebeekateeka omurimo gw'okugambaana n'abaana omu bwire bw'okutunguuka, ogutandika okubabuuza: "Orikwehurira ota ira?" Buli mwana agarukamu reero atoraho kamwe omu bakaada omwegyesa atekateekaniziize, orurikworeka emishomo etari emwe nk'okutangaara, okucweera, okutiina, ekiniga, obusaasi, n'okushemererwa. Ni by'okwega ki ebiri kukuzibwa ebikwata aha kukura kw'omuntu okurikurugamu omu murimo ogurikugambwaho?
answer_a: Kugamba ebi orikumvoora omu mutima
answer_b: Kumanya ebirikumeeza omutima
answer_c: Okuteekateeka ebi orikumanyisa omu bwangu
answer_d: Shuuruura eiziina

question: Ni enki aha bintu ebi orikwija kurora omwana w'eishomero rya kindagateni naabaasa kwefuga eby'okureeba n'enyegyezi ze?
answer_a: Juan Pablo akaba naayeikiriza muno kucweera omuzano gw'omwaka nk'ekiremwa, baitu habwokuba omwana ondi ahabire akatwara omugabo ogwo, nayikiriza kucweera nk'emwe aha mpara.
answer_b: Cristián naagamba aha nshuraniso z'ebyo arikukunda n'abanywani be b'omu क्लास aha mizano n'emizaano ey'omubishoori erikuzanwa aha ishomero.
answer_c: Paloma akagira oburemeezi bwingi omu kuhingura omurimo kandi, omu nteerane y'ekibiina, nashoboorora kandi naraga emiringo ei yakozeseize kukihangura.
answer_d: Rafaela yaajuna n'abaana abarikumwegaita omu kuorongora eby'okusaasaanisa, okubiha abaana abataagira beeka.

question: Okurikugyenda omu nyegyesa ya Kohlberg ey’okukura omu muringo, ni nshuro ki ahansi aha ezirikukurirana n’ekiteekateeko ky’ekicweka kya mbere eky’obuhangwa bw’omuntu obutakatunga?
answer_a: Ekirungi nikwo kukuratira amateeka obwo gari kugasa omuntu ondiijo wenka.
answer_b: Obusingye ni okukuratira amateeka omu muringo oguhikire, kwetantara ebihano.
answer_c: Ekirungi nikuhikiiriza emirimo ei waikiriziise obu abaandi baine kukora omu kibina.
answer_d: Ekirungi n'okutunga n'okutwarira nk'oku abantu abari haihi yaawe barikukwetenga.

question: Orurimi tibarazairwe nabo, nirwegyerezibwa kandi nikyesigamira aha mikago omuntu ataho n'abantu, hamwe n'obugabe, n'obugyenyi oburikubetaho. N'ahabw'ekyo, okusikara tikurikukiraho. Nirukura omu bice, kuruga aha kuzaarwa kuhika aha myaka y'eshomero. Enteekateeka egi y'okukura kw'orurimi nekwatanisa omuhandiiki ki?
answer_a: H. Maturana
answer_b: D. Ausubel
answer_c: L. Vygotsky
answer_d: J. Piaget

question: Okurikugyenda nk’oku J. Piaget yaagambire, emwe aha mpamirizo z’okugamba kw’abaana bato n’okugira ngu abaana nibakoresa amakuru g’ebigambo bingi kukurusha oku birikwetagisa. Omu bintu ebi ebiri ahansi, eki ki ekirikwohereza aha kyakoleberwa?
answer_a: Omwana agamba “ato” aha motoka y’okusaaniriza eshenyi ishe yaamuheire. Yaayorekwa motoka endiijo, agamba “ti ato”.
answer_b: Omwana, yaareeba ekishushani kye na nyina, yaagarukamu nawe: “omukundwa, murungi, ow’ekitiinisa” reero omwana yongyeraho “omukundwa munonga”
answer_c: Omwana agira ati “taata”, yaabaire nareeba ekishushani ky’omushaija orikugira omutwe gw’empuuta omu magazini
answer_d: Omwana naagira "taata" buli obu aheebwa eccupa ye

question: Omu omwegyesa omu ক্লাasi y'omupiira gw'engaro, abeeshuri babiri nibarikangaanira omupiira; omwe naatsindika omundiira kuba atware omupiira, kandi omundiira naagarukamu n'ebitukuto. Omwegyesa naayeta abeeshuri boona kubahurira ekyabaireho, kandi bwamara kubahurira, naakuratira ebiragiro ebirimu: okuhanangirira boona. Omwegyesa akakoresa muringo ki gw'okumaraho empaka?
answer_a: Okutegyereza
answer_b: Okutebeekanisa
answer_c: Okuhakanisa
answer_d: Okurizana omu kwikirizana.

question: Shoma ibara aha: Abaana babiri nibazaana kandi boona nibagamba omu kasumi kamwe, nibagamba ebi barikuteekateeka, nangwa hatariho ogurikugambira ondiijo. Okurikurugiira ahari J. Piaget, kicweka ki ky'okukura kw'obwomeezi eki kirikworekyerwa omu rurimi orurikworekwa omu mbeera egi eri ahaiguru?
answer_a: Eky'emyaka eteriire kukora
answer_b: Eky'obwengye n'omubiri omuheru
answer_c: Emikorwa yoona erikukuratira amateeka
answer_d: Emikorwa erikukozesa ebintu ebirikureebwa

question: Omugurusi nayenda kuha abeshomesa omurimo gw'okubagaruramu abarikukira omu kicweka kya 50% abataire ebiteebiso ebitari birungi omu kashozo. Ni nshangwa ki aha zirikukurira ezirikubaasa kutorana abaana aba?
answer_a: Omuringo ogurikukirayo kugwa omubara
answer_b: Omukenkye
answer_c: Omurungo oguri hagati
answer_d: Omuringo gw'okubaho

question: Shoma omwegyegyesa akora omurimo ogurikwetwa 'omwebembezi w'eizooba', ogurikugizibwa omwana, buri izooba, agabana n'abanywani be ebi arikukunda, ebi arikwetenga, n'emikoro arikukora arikukoresa ebishushani, ebijukizo, eby'okuzanisa, n'ebyafaayo. Omusingi gw'eby'obwegyesa guri omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Amakuru
answer_b: Omukago
answer_c: Obumo bw'enyima
answer_d: Obuhungiro burungi

question:
Shomaisho ki ky'omwana omuhwezi arikukwata orubumbo na omwana omu itsya omu kibira ky'ebyamashaza. Akwata orubumbo akagaburamu enshushani ibiri ezirikushushana. Obwo areka omwana akareeba, agira ati, "Ebice by'orubumbo nibishushana?" Omwana agira ati, "Ego, nibishushana." Obwo omuhwezi akakwata ekice kimwe akakirengyereza, abuuza ati, "Hati, ni kice ki kirimu orubumbo rwingi?" Omwana agira ati, "Eki nikyo kirimu orubumbo rwingi," areka ekice eki omuhwezi arengyereize.
Ni mugyenzi ki gw'okuteekateeka kw'omwana atakatandika kuteekateeka guri omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Okumaliriza
answer_b: Okuhindura
answer_c: Okukwata aha kintu kimwe
answer_d: Okureeta omuhendo gw'ebintu

question:
Orurimi nabwo niakamanyiso k’obushoboorozi bw’omuntu okukoresa ebimanyiso. Okukura kwarwo, nikyetenga okukura kw’obwomeezi n’emyekere.
Nigutiizi ki y’okukura y’orurimi ekwataniise n’omutwe ogu?
answer_a: Emyemerre
answer_b: Omwojo okwikiriza ngu ebintu bimwe tubizaarwa nabyo
answer_c: Okuteekateeka

question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa w’abaana abato naatebeekanisiza omuzanno gw’okwegyesa ogurikwetwa: “Kubura omu Kibira.” Nikigambwa aha baana abamwe ababurira omu kibira omurimu enyamaishwa, ebifo ebitakatandikirweho, obucweka obwirekwa, n’akabi kangi. Batakatandika omuzanno, baine kwetorana omweizi orikwija kubajuna. Omwegyesa bwanyima naayeta omwana omwe-omwe kushoboorora ahabw’enki barikwikiriza ngu nibo abarikukwata kubajuna, kandi abashabe kugaragaza amaani gaabo n’obureezi bwabo ahabw’omurimo ogwo. Nic’ekirikukwata aha kukura kw’omuntu ekirikukomezibwa omu baana n’ebirikurugamu?
answer_a: Okutegeera ebirooto by'omuntu ondiijo
answer_b: Okukuratira omutindo
answer_c: Okugumisiriza omuhendo gwawe
answer_d: Okukoragana

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi omuhango omu kikungu ky'abaana abato akareeba ngu Francisco, omwe aha baana abari omu kikungu, akora ebintu atarikuteekateeka kandi arakarirwa omu bwire bw'emirimo ya burijo. Arareetaana nari alarira ku arakuutsya kukora eki abaire naayenda kukora kandi atwara ebintu by'abaana, ekyarugamu okurwana omu bwire bwabo. Omwegyesereza ku aramubuuza ekirikumubaho nari eki arikuhurra, Francisco atunga amaisho, akwata amaboko ge, kandi tagira ky'agamba, agaana kugamba. Embeera egi egumizemu okubaho okumara esande nyinza bukuru kuruga omu kutandika kw'omwaka gw'eshomero. Omwegyesereza acwamu kukoragana nawe kumugumya obushoboorozi bwe obw'okumanya ebi arikuhurra. Omu mirimo ekurikukurataho, niki ekirikukwata gye okutandika omulingo ogu?
answer_a: Gambira Francisco obwo orikworeka ekyererezi ekibi, ngu asobole kukitegyeka.
answer_b: Teekanisa eby'omugani ebi Francisco yaabaire yeyorekiremu ekyoreka oku okwetenga kwe kumutwara kubi.
answer_c: Mugambire abanywani ba Francisco bamuhemu engyenderwaho z’oku kondoola enyehurizi ze.
answer_d: Ha Francisco aharizo orubaho orukumwegyerereza kworeka omuisho ogurikuhikaana n'enyemoozi ei arikukwata.

question: Omuhendo ogurikukurira: Omu kasumi k'okuruhuka aha b'ana bato, José naaza ahari Rocío omwegi mugyenziwe kumushaba kumuzaana, kwonka akagumizamu naazaana wenka. Eky'okuruhuka kihweire, José, anyamwire, atwara emirimo y'omwishiki n'ebipapuro, abita aha itaka, yaabyijagira. Rocío arira yaikiruka yaaza aha mwegyesa kumugambira ekyabaho. Omwegyesa, kucuura oburemeezi, yaaza ahari José, amushaba kureeba omwegi mugyenziwe, amubuuza oku arikuteekateeka ngu Rocío nayehurra na eki araakore kucuura embeera egi. Omwojo naaza ahari Rocío, amugwamu, yaamuhaayo kutorora ebipapuro n'okurongoosa emirimo. Twaba niturora embeera egi, ahabw'enki omuringo ogukozirwe omwegyesa nigubaasa kuhwera kukura obureezi bw'okutuura hamwe omuri José?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba nigegyesa omwana kuteenga ebirikwenda kukora.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba nikuhiga okugira embabazi aha bandi
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba nigegyesa omwana kutoorana amateeka g’emitwarize omunda ye.
answer_d: Ahabw'okuba nikireetera omwana kwega kworeka okukunda n'okufaaho abandi

question: Shoma eky'okushoma: Omu bwire bw'okukora emirimo, abaana babiri nibarwanira okukoresa ekishushani: Josefina asindika Marcos kumutwaara omuzano, na Marcos amugarukamu n'okumuteera omugyere. Omwegyesa naija kubahwera, bombi nibarira, nibageza kushoboorora ekyabaho. Omwegyesa abahumuriza reero ahurira buri omwe ekyamubaho. Ekyakurataho, abakunganya hamwe kugamba aha kyabaho naashoboorora ngu bashemereire kuhurikana n'ekitiinisa kandi batarikukoresa amaani kucuura enkaayana. Abagambira kworeka oku barikumara aha bukyezi bw'omwe nabo kandi ababuza oku barikuteekateeka ngu nibabaasa kucuura enkaayana. Josefina naateekateeka ngu bashemereire kwetonda na Marcos naateekateeka ngu bagabane ebice na bateere hamwe ekishushani. Bombi nibarikiriza eby'okugarukamu ebi kandi bagumizamu nibazaana. Ni bumwe aha buringaaniza bw'enkaayana obw'obusingye obu omwegyesa akoresa omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Okuhakanisa
answer_b: Okutegyereza
answer_c: Kworobiirikya
answer_d: Okutungaana

question: Shoma omubaireki w’abaana abato ari kukora omu kicweka ky’orurimi omu kushoma n’ekarte enu, ei arikuzuuriza hamwe n’abaana omu mutwe gwe. Obureezi ki obw’orurimi oburikukura kuraba omu bikoreso ebikozesibwe omu murimo ogu?
answer_a: Okumanya amakuru g'ebigambo n'emiramu
answer_b: Okumanya eby'amaisho by'endimi
answer_c: Okumanya ebirikukorwa omu bwire oburikwija
answer_d: Okumanya eby'emiramwa n'enteekateeka y'ebigambo

question: Omuhendo gw'okushushana gw'abaana omu bintu ebikuratiraho nigumanyisibwa guta?
answer_a: Omuhendo gw'ebishushani nigwoleka gye emiterere, omukago gw'ebara ry'ekintu n'ebikorwa ebirimu.
answer_b: Omuntu naayoreka omu muringo gw'akacurama, ebintu bikataandika kwongyerwaho, kandi hakabaaho okutaana.
answer_c: Hariho ekishushani ekikuru n'obusaasi nibyo byona ebiri omuhanda gw'ekishushani eki, ebindi bintu nibyerembera okukirikurugaana.
answer_d: Emihembo negyendesereza, nobwengye bw'okushushana niburiyo, kwonka omukago gw'ebara ry'ekintu tigurikukwata.

question:
Shoma omwegyegyesa alikukiriza kwongyera aha kworekereza kw'obuhangwa kuraba omu kukuzamu obureezi bw'abaana abari omu kibiina kye eky'abaana abato.
Omu mirimo ekurikukurira, niki ekirikukirayo kwikirana kukikorera ekigyendererwa kye?
answer_a: Okushushani omuhanda kushushana ebishushani orikureeba ebintu byobutonde ebirikutaana
answer_b: Okuririmba enyimba ez'omutaano hambukiraaho n'okukomera ebintu ebirikukora oruyoogo.
answer_c: Okuzina orukundo rw'omuziki hano no kutegyeka omuringo gw'okugyenda n'omuhuumuro.
answer_d: Kutebeeka ekikomo ky'ebishushani norikukoresa empapura z'emiringo etari emwe, obukuru butari bumwe, n'emitwarize etari emwe

question: Omugyezibwa omuhiga owa kiraasi ya 4, orikukora n'abegi be aha burenganzira bw'abaana, areeta embeera egi: "Anita akakubatwa omutwe munonga obu yagwa kuruga aha kasiringi arikushambaazana na bagenzi be omu kibanja ky'eishomero. Enyima y'akabi ako, Anita akatwarwa bwangu omugyezibwa we aha bureeberezi bw'obutaazi, ahu yaatungire oburemeezi oburikwetagisa." Hanyuma, omugyezibwa nagambira abegi kumanya oburenganzira obu Anita arikukoresa omu mbeera erikugambwaho kandi, okuhereza embeera endiijo ahu oburenganzira obwo bumwe burikwija kwemererwa. Ni kimwe aha by'okurorraho ebi ekirikukwata aha kucweekereza okwega kw'abegi omu murimo ogwaherize kuteekwa omugyezibwa?
answer_a: Nibamannya oburengane bukuru bw'abaana
answer_b: Nibarikira oburengane obu bakoresa omu magara gaabo ga burijo n'eby'okureeberaho ebirikukwata aha nshonga.
answer_c: Nibakora okucwamu ebi barikuteekateeka aha bukuru bw'okukora omubiri n'okurinda oburenganzira bwabo
answer_d: Nibamanya ebi ebireetera okutatiira amateeka g'abaana

question: Omwegyesi w’ebyeshure nashemererwa omurimo ogurikwija kukorerwa abashaija n’abakazi omu kibinja kye, abanaaba nibakyarirwa abana ba gireedi ya mbere kuruga omu ishomero. Ku baraahikye, omwana weena ow’akasomesa araashutama haihi n’omwana wa gireedi ya mbere, kandi nibaija kuhigwa kumenyana kuraba omu kubuurirana. Enyima y’ekyo, nibaija kukora ekishushani hamwe, barugye aheeru omu kibanja kugabana emizaano. Obu baraamare, nibaija kuganira omu kibinja ekikuru aha byo baaba bahikiriize hamwe. Omusingi gw’ebyeshure ki ogurikukuzibwa munonga n’obuhangwa obu bw’okwega?
answer_b: Omukago
answer_c: Amakuru
answer_d: Obushoboorozi

question: Omwegyesi, omu bwiire bw'okuteeranira hamwe, naayeta abashaija n'abashiki kubahoora ekintu eki baahikiriizeho omu bwiire obuhwaireho. Kuguha eky'okureeberaho ky'omugisha ogwo, n'abagambira ngu naagyenda omu mashomo g'okwegyesa omubiri (yoga) kandi ngu n'amaani maingi yaashoboirwe kukora omuringo gw'entare. Omushiki nagamba ngu yaashoboirwe kuruka n'amaguru goona hamwe, omushaija naagamba ngu yaashoboirwe kutaaha eriisho rimwe. Omu mbeera erikugambwaho, niki ekirikukuzibwa omu biteekateeko by'omuntu ebirikukwata aha kwetegyereza?
answer_a: Okutegeera ebirooto by'omuntu ondiijo
answer_b: Obwesigye
answer_c: Okwetegyereza
answer_d: Okumuhurira ngu ori omwe aha bantu

question: Andrea na Jacinta nibarikwenda omu kashanku k'okubaka, nibarikiriganwa kubaka omunaara muraiha kurusha endiijo n'ebitare. Andrea akareeba ngu omunaara gw'omunywani we nigwo muraiha kurusha ogwe, n'ahabw'ekyo aterera eitaare kumugwisa, yabaasa kukihikiiriza. Obwo, Jacinta arakaliirwa yaatera eitaare omu mutwe. Omwegyesa, areeba obuzibu obwo, ahwera kuhika kubagambira yaacwamu kukoresa omuringo gw'okucwa orubanza omu by'obwegyesa. Twaba niturora embeera eyo n'omuringo ogurikugambwaho, niki ekintu kya bwambere omwegyesa ashemereire kukora?
answer_a: Shoborora obuteerane
answer_b: Gamba ebirikukora.
answer_c: Ebiragiro ebirikukuratirwa
answer_d: Shuuruura obuteeteerane

question: Omu kweshushanisa n'okushamba nk'omurimo gw'omubiri ogurikutebeekanisibwe, omuntu ashanga emyaka eriiha emwe aha mikaro mikuru y'okushamba neehikaana n'okwetaba kw'omuntu omwe wenka omu mwanya gw'okukoragana hamwe?
answer_a: Emyaka 6
answer_b: Emyaka 8
answer_c: Emyaka 10
answer_d: Emyaka 12

question: Ni omuhandiiki ki aha abarikukurira abirikushobora omu nyegyesa yaabo y'okukura kw'omubiri, ebicweka bina kuruga omu mubiri ogurikukora ebintu by'amaani okuhika aha mubiri ogurikushushana kuruga aha myaka efu okuhika aha 12?
answer_a: Piaget
answer_b: Le Boulch

question: Omuriki oriku aha butoosa nibwo bukwatanisa embeera z'okwega eza Piaget na Vygotsky?
answer_a: Okutebeekanisa kw’endimi z’abaana omu biteekerezo byabo
answer_b: Orurimi nk'ekintu kikuru omu kukura kw'obwengye
answer_c: Obukuru bw'ebikoreso by'obuhangwa omu kukuza amajyambere
answer_d: Okuteekateeka omuntu omu omwe n'okumwesiga nk'ekyetago ekikuru omu kukora emirimo y'okwega

question: Tweshangire aha bushobozi bw’okukura kw’obwomeezi, niki ekirikubaasa kureebwa nk’enjorekyerero aha biteekateeko bya Piaget na Vygotsky?
answer_a: Ahari Piaget, nikirikurugamira aha ky’omuntu aherereire; kwonka ahari Vygotsky, nikirikurugamira aha itungo ry’okukura erya haihi.
answer_b: Ahari Piaget, nikirikugyezaho n'omuringo ogu omuntu arikwetegyereza n'okuhindura ebintu; kwonka ahari Vygotsky, nikirikugyezaho n'omuringo ogu omuntu arikuhabwa obuhabuzi.
answer_c: Ahari Piaget, nikirikuruga aha miringo etaanu y'emikoreso omuntu arikubaasa kukora; kwonka ahari Vygotsky, nikirikuruga aha kubaho nari obutabaho bw'omwegyesi nari omwebemberi.
answer_d: Ahari Piaget, nikirikuruga omu muringo ebyiciro by’okukura nibitsindikirwa; kwonka ahari Vygotsky, nikirikuruga omu muringo omurimo gurikugumira kukora.

question: Omuhanda gw'okuteekateeka nk'omuringo gw'okumaraho oburemeezi, ekikorekyo ki aha bi orikuronda nikyo kirikukwatanisa n'okukoresa okuteekateeka kw'omutaano?

answer_b: Shwijuma omu miringo etatarikwendaana ey'okugarukamu n'okukora.
answer_c: Shaka enyakushuura erikuhikire omu kibanja eki tutarikumanya
answer_d: Yegyesereza omuringo gw'okumaraho ebizibu omu byanya ebigumire

question: Ni enyegyesere ki aha nshoborora obwengye erikukurirana n'emiteekateeka ya Gardner y'obwengye bwingi?
answer_a: Obwengye ni okuhanga ebintu ebiriyo omugasho omu bwijwire bumwe nari obwingi bw'obuhangwa.
answer_b: Obwengye ni kwoleka obushoboorozi oburikukiraho omu kucumura ebizibu.
answer_c: Obwengye n'obushoboorozi bw'abantu okwetegyereza n'okumanya ebirikumutima byabo hamwe n'eby'abandi.
answer_d: Obwengye n'obushoboorozi bw'okwetwara omu kuza ebigyendererwa by'omuntu omu mbeera z'abantu ezirikugumira kandi zigumire.

question: Ni enyegyesere ki aha bigambo ebi erikwohereza omukago murungi hali okukuura kw'omukago n'enyegyesere z'omutima omu bwomeezi bw'omumaisho; okukurikira enyegyesere ya Bowlby?
answer_a: Abantu abakuratira omuntu abarikubariirira atari maama owaabo buzare tibarikukuratira kugira emikago ey'obwesigye.
answer_b: Abantu abarikugira abareeberezi abahindura amaani g'okubareeberera omu myaka ey'obuto nibooreka okukura kw'obwetengyeerwa omu by'okumanya ebirikumuteera.
answer_c: Abantu ababaire bataine abantu ababarikubakwataho omu buto bwabo nibabaasa kutoorana abantu abandi abarikubahwera, kwonka nibenda kugira obuteesigwa bwingi.
answer_d: Abantu abatabaire bagira omukago omu myaka yabo ey'obuto nibooleka omuringo gw'okushaba obuhwezi n'okusiimaana, hamwe n'okwoleka ebirikumutwara omu mutima, kaba kiri kirungi nari kibi.

question: Ni enki ekikuru kukuratira omuntu okumanya oburemeezi bw’omutwe kurugiirira omu mbeera y’obuntu n’obw’abantu?

answer_b: Okwetegyereza omuntu aine obushoboorozi bw'okukora ebintu omu nsi

question: Okurikugyenderera aha mitero ya Kohlberg y'okukura omu muringo, niki abantu abarikumarira okukura kwabo aha mutendera gw'enyima y'emigyenzo barikuba nibashobora kukora?

answer_c: Kwetegyereza okuhendera kw'ebiragiro n'okucwamu ebyaawe.

question:
Omuringo ogu gukozesibwe gwayambazire omu by’okwegyesa abato enyima, eby’okuhandiika ebirikukwata aha muringo gw’okwegyesa, abakuru nibo batunga obuhame kurabira omu miringo etari emwe n’emwe, nk’ebyahandiikwa, ebifaananyi, na vidiyo. question: Okurikugyenda omuri Piaget, omugasho gw'okuzana eby'okufaananya kushaani omu kukura kw'obwomeezi bw'omwana niki?
answer_a: Nikwetwara, okurabira omu kukora, kutebeza obushoboorozi bw’okuhinduka n’embeera, n’okugumya obushoboorozi bwabo bw’omubiri.
answer_b: Nikwetwaza, kurabira omu kurundarunda ebintu, okukuza okwetegyereza ebintu omu mwanya, enshonga n'ebirikurugamu, hamwe n'okureeba emiterere y'ebintu
answer_c: Nikukwatagira, kurabira omu kwegyerera, okukuza obushoboorozi bw'okutaanura eby'efaananizo n'ebyahabwomeezi, n'okugumya okwetegyereza kwabo.
answer_d: Nikwetwamu, okurikuraba omu kwikiriza amateeka, okukuza obureezi nk'okucumura ebizibu, okuteekateeka, n'okushwijuma amagezi.

question: Kurugiirikana n'enyegyesa ya Piaget, omu muringo ogurikukurikira ogu, niki ekirikworeka ngu omwana ari haihi kuhikiiriza ekyanya ky'okumanya n'okukora?
answer_a: Pía arikukwatanisa ebicuukye by'ekicweka ky'ekiteeko naaza kubyetorora, naageza kubiteeka hamwe.
answer_b: Rafael naagyira ekibubi ky'enkika ekiri ahansi, yaagenda aha meza yaakiteeka aha nkika.
answer_c: Andrea naashuuru omupiira ogwagwiire ahansi y'emeza kandi areeba oruhande oru n'oru orikutandika kumushanga.
answer_d: Pedro aseka buri obu arikunkumura ekicweka ky'okusekera kandi kirikumika. Obu kiragwa hasi kikatembagura, nakikuratira okuhitsya obu akitwara obundi.

question:

Eki, agabura ekibiinja omu tubinja tubiri: ekimwe nikikora akapande k'eby'okurya birungi n'ekindi, akapande k'eby'okurya bibi. Okumaliriza, nibamurika hamwe kandi bagakuraho ebyo barikumarwa.
Ni by'okwega ki eki kikorwa ekirikukirayo kukuriza omu baana?
answer_a: Okukora ebipande ebirimu obwomeezi
answer_b: Kugambira abandi ebi barikuteekateeka n'ebarikucwamu
answer_c: Kuhereza ekitiinisa omu kubuurira n'okuheereza kw'abandi
answer_d: Kwetegyereza embeera ezirikukusobozesa kwetaho.

question: Omwegyesi w’abaana naacwamu kuha abaana emirimo erikukwata aha kureeberera ebimera ebiri omu kicweka. Abaabuuza kubagambira eki baraakunde kukora. Abaana bagira bati: “Ninkunda okushushana; ndyakora ekishushani kya buri kimera,” “Ninkunda kureeberera abandi, owaanyu nindeba embwa yangye… ndyabihyiira amaizi!” Ni nkuru ki aha kukura kw’omuntu abu abaana barikworeka omu bigambo byabo?

answer_b: Okwetegyereza omuntu nk'oku ari
answer_c: Kwetegyekanisa
answer_d: Okukunda omuntu omwe nk'oku ari

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi w’abaana abato, okukora aha mugyigirizo ogurikugyenda n’amaisho ogurikugira ngu: “Kukora ebintu omu muringo ogurikwekwataho, okugaziya obwomeezi bwe, kurugiirira aha byo ayenda n’ebi arikukunda”, naashaba omwana omwe na omwe kuterekera hamwe ebintu byoona byabaire bikozirweho bwaba buhendera omu myanya eyateekanisiibwe. Omwegyesi naareeba ngu Matilda naatereka ebintu atarikukuratira ebirango ebiri aha meza, naabiteeka omu myanya etari emwe. Ni muringo ki gw’okukwatanisa oguraahe Matilda eby’okugarukamu ebirikugyenda nibimubuurira kandi bigashe aha kutuura aha mugyigirizo ogurikugyenda n’amaisho ogurateekanisiibwe?
answer_a: "Matilda, akacupa ako kaine emicweka n'ebikaati by'omubaro tikarikugenda aha, orikuteekateeka ngu nikabaasa kugyenda nkahi?"; omwishiki areeba aha birango yaashanga omwanya ogurikukwata.
answer_b: "Matilda, akacupa ako kaine emicwe n'ebaruha z'omubaro nikaza ahari eryo?" Omwegyesa naamwijutsya ngu ashemereire kureeba aha birango kumanya ebi buri kintu kirikugyenda; omwishiki naareeba yaabiteeka omu mwanya ogurikubaasa.
answer_c: Matilda, reeba aha kaarati eri ahansi y'ekibbo eki omazire okuterekamu, neeba neehwana n'ebintu ebi orikutereka? Omwegyesa amworeka ahu ekisiisi kiri; omwishiki natereka ebintu omu mwanya ogwo ogworekwa.
answer_d: Matilda, ngyire nkureeba ngu obitungire omuhanda nkoku nkwendaire, kwonka oshemereire kureeba ki kumanya ahu birikugenda? Omurundi ogurikwija, yetegyereza gye ahu orikubaasa kubitunga orikureeba abanywani baawe abarikukora.

question: Omwegyesi n’agyezaho kwegyesa ekigyendererwa ky’okwega ekirikukurira aha Mbeera z’Obu সোসাইটি n’Obutuurwa: “Kworeka okusiima omu kwegaita n’abahungu n’abashiki, noomanya obutaanwa bw’emitwarize yaabo.” Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira aha kwetegyereza ezirikukwata aha kupima oku ekigyendererwa eki kyahikiiriziibwe?
answer_a: Koresa orutindo rw'okwetegyereza obu barikwaza omu rubaraza n'abaana abarikuruga omu mitendera etari emwe
answer_b: Koresa omuko gw'okukora orubriki abaana nibetaba omu kumurikwa kw'ebishushani by'emiryango yaabo
answer_c: Koresa ekyegeranyo ky'okugera obuhendo abahungu n'abashiki abarikukora ebibuuzo n'abantu abari omu itungo
answer_d: Koresa eby’okukoresa omu kwegyesa abana nibeetabamu omu murikaguro gw’ebihangwa by’ensi yoona.

question: Omukoki gw’abaana omuhanda owa siniya gwine abaana ikumi. Boona bagyenda omuhanda ogwo barikugumisiriza kandi nibashemeererwa eby’okugyenda. Baatanire kworeka okukunda okusoomoozebwa nk’okutwara, okuhisha, okuteeka ebintu kimwe aha kindi, n’okugyunga ebintu. N’ahabw’ekyo, omwegyesa arateekanisa kwegyesa ebigyendererwa by’okwega ebi: “Kugezesa ebintu kurabira omu kumara embeera ezirikwooreka, nk’okushika aha bintu, okuhiga obutooni aha by’okurira, okugyaho eby’okuzanisa omu byombo, okucweeka ebintu, n’ebindi” kandi “Kworeka okukunda n’okusemererwa obu barikugyenda omuhanda ogwo omu mbeera za buri izooba n’ez’okuzana”. Twaba nitureeba emitwarize y’omukoki gw’abaana aba, ni muringo ki gw’okwegyesa ogurikwija kureka omwegyesa kwegyesa ebigyendererwa ebi yatondire?
answer_a: Okushamba kw'ebirikuranga: abaana nibashoma, nibakwata kandi nibagatta ebintu, nibashanga ensi omu muringo gwabo.
answer_b: Omugisha gw'okutendeka omubiri: abaana bahikiiriza omurongo gw'ebintu ebihendahenda ebirimu okusoomooza okutaani-taani, kurugiirira aha muringo ogurikugyendererwa.
answer_c: Ekitebe ky'eby'omugisha: abaana bashuuruura bariire omu ntebe omuhendo erimu ebintu bya buri izooba n'ebimwe ebyatooranirwe
answer_d: Okuteera omuhendo gw'ebya'buhangwa: abaana nibazaana, nibegyezamu kandi nibakwatanisa n'ebintu birungi ebirikushushana ebirikutebeekanisibwa omu mwanya.

question:
Omugyezibwa omu, orikwegyesa abaana b'eky'omukaaga omuhanda, ateekateeka kukora aha bintu ebirikukwata aha rurimi n'okugumya obwengye bw'emikono. Kandi, akora ekintu eki: Abaana, nibakuratira orugano, nibeesiga nk'abanyazi b'omu nyanja nibasherura esente ezihisirwe omu ka, ezi baine kuta omu mwanya gw'ekisanduuko ky'obugagga. Omwegyesa areeba ngu Amanda akagumize esente ze omu mufuko, n'ahabw'ekyo omwegyesa amubuuza ahabw'enki atazitire omu kisanduuko ky'obugagga, kandi yaagarukamu ati: "Tindikubaasa kuta esente omukyo ahabw'okuba zigwa."
Ni buha bw'obuhabuzi obu omwegyesa arakuhe Amanda kubaasa kutunga eby'okugarukamu ebirikumuhiga kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwega?
answer_a: "Amanda, kwata ebicweka by'entaashe omu nshaho zaawe, reero ndyakuhwereza kubita omunda." Muhwereze okubita omunda. Bwanyima omubuuze: "Orikubaasa kugeza okukora eki wenka?"
answer_b: Amanda, nooyenda kugeza n'akabokisi k'ebicweka akandi? Ndiineho eizo zirimu obucweka obukuru kandi ekyo nikibaasa kuba kyanguhire. Nooyenda kugeza omurundi ogundi? Ndaakuhe obwire obwingi.
answer_c: Amanda, orikwenda obuhwezi? Nooyenda omuntu akworeke oku orikuta omubyoya? Reeba omwegi mugenzi waawe ogwo, nabikora gye, yemerera haihi nawe nukwo orikugyezaho kutoora.
answer_d: "Amanda, oranyoreeka kworeka oku orikukikora? Ahabw'enki orikuteekateeka ngu torikubaasa kuta omusharire omunda? Noobaasa kukikora omuhanda ogundi?" Waamara kuhurikiza eby'arikuzaamu, yoreka oku orikukora n'omusharire kandi mwegyerereze hamwe.

question:
Omugyezibwa asomesa aine kwotorana ekikoreso ky'eteknologiya ekyorobereza okuhurirana omu baine ekiina na boona hamwe n'omwegyesa; nikikiza kugaabana n'okuhindura ebihandiiko omu bwire bumwe; kandi nikibaasa kutebeekanisa emirimo n'okugiha omu baine ekiina boona.

answer_d: Omukura gw'okuhereeza ebirowoozo omu bwangu nk'ogwa Marqueed

question: Omwegyesereza w’ekicweka ky’EMTP acwireho kukora aha kamembe k’okwegyesa akarikukwata aha Bukoramanzi n’okubaasika kukora. Kurugiirira aha kicweka ky’obuhame omwegyesa araabe aine kukora kuruga omu murimo ogukozirwe abegyeki, niki ekikoreso ky’okushwijuma ekirikubaasa kukoresibwa?

answer_c: Ebibuuzo eby'okuhandiika
answer_d: Okugyezibwa kw'obwengye

question: Shoma omwe orikukurataho nagwo: Emwe aha biteekerezo bye ebirikukwata aha by’obureezi n’enyegyesa n’omugasho mwingi n’enyegyesa y’okwegyesa okurikukirizibwa (Mediated Learning Experience - MLE), egi erikugambira ngu abantu nibabaasa kuhinduka omu biteekerezo byabo. MLE negambwa ngu n’omutindo gw’omukago gw’abantu n’obutaaho bwabo, ogurikwetengyesa kushoboorora omuringo ebiteekerezo birikukora nk’ekirikurugamu omu kuhingura emicwe. Kuruga omu muringo ogu, omuringo gw’okwegyesa ogurikukirizibwa nigutwarwa nk’ogurikwongyera amaani g’omuntu kugira ngu atungye okwega okw’omugasho, okwetegyereza ngu kurabira omuri gwo, omuntu naabaasa kuhindura okwega okwatungire omu mbeera yoona akabaasa kukukoresa omu mbeera endiijo nari embeera ezindi, nikikwata aha kureeta okumanya kw’omuntu arikuruga omu byamubaireho omu kwega kusya. Omuhandiiki ki orikukurataho ou kiteekerezo eki kirikugambwaho omu mutwe gw’okwegyesa n’okwega ekirikugambwa ngu nikye?
answer_a: John Dewey
